Description:
Dyson solves real-world problems and creates better products through the application of engineering, science, design and creativity. It is a family-owned, global technology company, founded by Sir James Dyson who remains at the helm alongside his son Jake. 

Since inventing the first cyclonic bagless vacuum cleaner, the DC01, Dyson has consistently invested in research and development to improve its products and technologies radically. Dyson offers products across a growing range of areas: floorcare, air purification, robotics, haircare including formulations, lighting, hand drying, and most recently audio. Dyson continues to expand into new areas.

Today, Dyson sells products in more than 80 markets, has 450 Dyson stores worldwide and is available in all major technology and beauty retailers. Dyson has global headquarters in Singapore and major technology campuses in Singapore, the UK, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global team of engineers, scientists and software developers are focused on developing technology-enabled products which work better and which people love to use. Key areas of focus have included high-speed electric digital motors, sensing and vision systems, robotics, machine learning and aerodynamics. 

Beyond products, to encourage an inventive future, Dyson is also inspiring the next generation of engineers and inventors through the Dyson Institute of Engineering and Technology, the James Dyson Foundation and the James Dyson Award.  

The Dyson family applies its problem-solving approach in other fields, and established Dyson Farming in 2012. It is one of the largest farming businesses in the UK, extending to 36,000 acres across Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, Gloucestershire and Somerset. A typical application may be to provide commercial ventilation and heating for comfort in an office or workplace. At Neatafan Ltd, components can be provided to achieve any of these needs and we have been heralded as pioneers in the commercial and industrial ventilation markets. In fact, we were the first company to manufacture heaters with built-in controls enabling the user to control the required temperature, humidity and comfort levels. 

Since 1983 and to the present day we continue to invest heavily in the research and design of new systems in order to remain at the forefront of the commercial ventilation industry. Being a UK based company you can be sure of the highest level of quality and rest assured that all our products are tested to the latest EU industrial standards. Systems can be specifically designed to suit the customer’s available space, product range and specific needs for various industries and environments.

Since our commercial ventilation systems are tailored to meet your specific requirements, it allows us to export our systems across the world for any commercial ventilation application. Portable Appliance Testing is where electrical appliances are routinely checked to see whether they are safe for continued use within the workplace.

Name: Approved Cables Initiative
Description:
The Approved Cables Initiative (ACI) works to highlight the dangers associated with substandard cable product to the cable industry and end users. Where substandard or counterfeit cable is found, the ACI informs industry regulators and legislators (HSE, Trading Standards, MHCLG) so that the public as well as industry can be made aware and protected.
As part of its work the ACI campaigns for change to UK legislation to stop the import of dangerous cable and to increase the penalties for infringements. 
Those with information about a suspect cable should contact the ACI and supply a five-metre cable sample to enable it to be tested. If found to be unsafe, information is supplied to authorities for further action.
The ACI works with supply chain representative bodies including Electric Distributors Association (EDA); Electric Contractors Association (ECA); Electric Safety First; British Cables Association (BCA); Energy Networks Association (ENA); Certsure, SELECT and the Joint Industry Board (JIB). It can also provide advice concerning suspect cable to specifiers, contractors, installers, wholesalers and distributors.

We deliver the solution to hand-arm vibration monitoring for operator and employer. Established in 2006 our unique dosimetry based solution is the only system to measure actual vibration received by operators.

The concept which led to the development of the HAVSense product germinated back in 2000. This was when the EU was developing the ‘Physical Agents’ Directive. This Directive included vibration as a potential health hazard that needed to be ‘controlled’. At that time, no realistic technology was available that could provide vibration monitoring of the hand. So the initial work focussed on the investigation of several cutting edge technologies that may have been capable of providing a solution. This research work was awarded a prestigious DTI Smart award and resulted in the identification of the methodology used in the Dosimeters today. Over a decade of further development work led to the launch of the unique HAVSense system, the only system that actually measures the vibration transmitted to the hand of the operator and which can assess and calculate HSE points and provide visual warnings and a full second by second record of the dosage.

Name: Allen & Heath
Description:
Allen & Heath is a UK based designer of digital and analogue audio mixing consoles for live sound, AV, installation, recording and DJs. 

Allen & Heath was in the vanguard of the first wave of great British mixer companies, starting life at the heart of London’s swinging music scene in 1969. In those early days Allen & Heath hand-built mixers for the top bands of the era, including Genesis, Pink Floyd and The Who. Today’s Allen & Heath range is used and loved by bands, rental companies, installers, houses of worship, DJs, clubs, broadcasters and studios in virtually every country across the globe.

We design and specify all our mixers here at our headquarters in beautiful Cornwall, UK. Our world class R&D team has kept us at the leading edge of mixing technology and is committed to harnessing the best technologies and materials to give our customers the best possible mixing experience. Many key members of the Allen & Heath team are active sound engineers with years of hands-on experience, and we’re fortunate to have a network of leading audio professionals whose feedback helps to shape our designs to meet our customers’ real-world needs. One of the cornerstones of the company is our shared passion for audio excellence, both in the analogue domain and in our digital systems, where we have won high praise from some of the most discerning ears in the business for the faithfulness of our FX and processing emulations.

From the tiny ZED-i8 to the largest dLive pro touring system, all mixers bearing the Allen & Heath logo are designed to our exacting audio and build quality standards. With a strong team behind us and our best ever product range, we’re set to play a leading role in mixing technology in the years and decades ahead.

Allen & Heath is part of the Audiotonix group, alongside acclaimed audio brands, Digico, Calrec and DigiGrid.

Employing around 260 people at the site in Whitstable, Kent, Amphenol LTD offers a full design and manufacturing service for a large range of connectors and interconnect solutions, including cable assembly, over-moulding and electronic packaging. In the age of globalisation, Amphenol LTD is proud to have retained full end-to-end manufacturing capability for its products in the UK, whilst having opened access to low cost manufacturing sites around the world to complement its offering to customers globally.
 
Accredited to AS9100, an innovative and leading edge manufacturer of both connectors and interconnect systems for applications within the Military and Aerospace markets, Amphenol LTD is dedicated to providing customers with the latest technology to meet the needs of interconnection in a variety of challenging applications.
 
With engineering and customer service teams based out of our manufacturing site in Whitstable we are the local point of contact for our UK customers to access the full Amphenol product portfolio and for our global customers to access the specialist products and services that Amphenol LTD can provide.

Name: Bowers Electricals Ltd
Description:
Bowers Electricals are in the 70th year of powering industry and one of the worlds biggest designers and suppliers of energy saving EU Compliant Tier 1 and Tier 2 Distribution and Power Transformers. 

Tier 1 & 2 Distribution Transformers are manufactured in accordance with EU Regulation typically ranging from 50kVA to 3150kVA with voltage ratios 3.3kV, 6.6kV, 11kV &33kV step down to 415v, vector Dyn11 and include extended voltage tapping range -5% to +7.5%

Tier 1 & Tier 2 Package Substation Transformers are manufactured in line with the Energy Network Association  Technical Specifications (ENATS) ENA-TS-35-1

New for 2018 our Amorphous Core Range of Transformers, which already meet the Tier 2 EU Eco-design pecifications ahead of the 2021 deadline. 

Bowers Electricals pride itself on 3 core values: 
-On-Time Delivery 
-Focused Customer Service
-Quality at the Right Price

We can help you to solve ALL your Electrical Power Equipment needs. 
Just call our team on +44 (0) 1773 531531 or email us at enquiries@bowerselec.co.uk

Name: Electric Center
Description:
Electric Center was formed back in October 2006 following the merger of AC Electrical and William Wilson electrical branches.

Since then we have expanded our branch network and developed new branches throughout the UK to offer our customers a better, brighter service from over 110 branches nationwide.

Electric Center seeks to bring a new approach to customer service in the world of electrical wholesaling harnessing the power of our local branch network, expertise and relationships with suppliers.

Our aim is quite simple – to become the first choice wholesaler for our customers whatever their requirements, large or small. That is why we have made three simple but powerful promises which will guide our business into the future:

We are committed to understanding your business, we aim to make our customers lives simple and finally we deliver on our promises.

Name: Hyfire
Description:
Work with Hyfire for the best technology and service in EN54-25 wireless fire detection and alarm systems.

Established in 2007, Hyfire is an integral component of Orama, a group of market leading wireless businesses united by a strong commitment to keeping people and their environment safe using the power of wireless technology and digital systems, creating value and opportunities for our customers and society. 

Hyfire has emerged as a beacon of excellence in the industry by pioneering the introduction of some of the first commercial wireless detection and alarm devices that are fully certified to EN54 standards. The launch of the last Taurus wireless product line has positioned Hyfire at the forefront of technological advancement in fire safety.  It is the preferred wireless solution for many in social housing, hi-rise residential accommodation, historic buildings, retail, commerce, education, government, healthcare and industrial markets.

The Hyfire wireless fire alarm and detection solution is extremely popular because it can be used in a multitude of sectors where minimum disruption is required. It is an ideal solution within the education, heritage and retail sector because there is minimal disruption to day to day operations. Installation time is kept to a minimum which results in cost savings. 

Setting a benchmark for assurance, Hyfire’s devices come with a comprehensive five-year warranty. To further enhance customer satisfaction, the company has implemented a dedicated partner programme, ensuring optimal support for survey installation, commissioning, after-sales service, and unparalleled technical assistance. Hyfire stands as a symbol of quality and excellence, embodying a steadfast commitment to elevating safety standards in the commercial fire sector.

Name: LAND
Description:
Every degree counts. Accurate temperature measurement is critical in today’s factories and plants. So you can boost your production, better protect your people, and reduce your environmental impact.

Get precision performance even in the harshest conditions with LAND. Improve product quality and process efficiency with actionable insights from our infrared pyrometers, line scanners, and thermal imaging systems. Embrace the digital revolution with expert support that can help you design, install,
and maintain our smart solutions.

For over 75 years, we’ve been world leaders in industrial infrared temperature measurement. Setting new standards for quality, we calibrate our instruments in ISO17025 laboratories and offer extended protection. We continue to develop solutions for diverse applications – from sustainable steelmaking
to battery production for electric vehicles.

Name: Constant Power Solutions Ltd
Description:
Constant Power Solutions Ltd prides itself in being a dedicated UK supplier & manufacturer of generators and high-quality power equipment. Knowing that satisfaction and quality is a must in this industry, European-sourced components and highly skilled engineers are used for the assembly of our products. 
We provide turn-key small and large generator solutions and services.  With a flexible production line we can fully customise the products to suit your needs. Our dedicated team of professional technical engineers can provide, source and solve any power requirements you may have. 
Our servicing and spare parts division can offer service contracts and a 24 hour call out service for a whole range of services such as engine & alternator repairs, generator servicing and general maintenance. Our spare parts team can supply you with original manufacturers' and official distributors’ parts. it’s important for us to supply directly from the source.

Name: BISOL Group
Description:
BISOL Group is a European manufacturer passionate about implementing the highest industry standards into top quality solar products. Our highly skilled personnel places BISOL under the limelight of the world’s leaders in the solar industry. BISOL experts are continuously inventing new creative solutions that are trendsetting the present and shaping the future.

In BISOL, quality always comes first!

Description:
Yamaichi Electronics is an internationally renowned electronics company; we are a leading designer and manufacturer of electro-mechanical components. Name: Morphy Richards UK
Description:
When Morphy met Richards

In 1936 Donal Morphy met Charles Richards. Engineer met salesman. Technology met human. Function met form. And with that, they set out to make our lives easier and our homes happier.

Morphy and Richards have always represented the best of British design and that particularly British tradition of bringing different worlds and ideas together. Reliability and refinement, craftsmanship and quirk; that's the legacy we're continuing today - building pioneering products that simply make things better.

Sustainability isn't a new engineering problem. Just create things that people need - make it once and make it last. Because when things are made properly, you need fewer repairs and fewer replacements. We're bringing sustainable innovation to everyone.

As of August 2023 Consumer Brands Limited is now the official licensee of Morphy Richards in the UK.
Location: Stoke On Trent, England, United Kingdom

Name: VeriVide Limited
Description:
VeriVide provides equipment to measure and assess the colour and appearance of products, objects, samples and ingredients. Manufacturing LED Light Booths and Colour Assessment Cabinets for retailers and suppliers, plays a core part of the business. Many of our products set the visual appearance standards that suppliers, through to major retailers, must meet. VeriVide customers range from multinationals to small enterprises in sectors including textiles and apparel, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, automotive, print and packaging. VeriVide colour viewing cabinets are used around the world and are specified by major global retailers.

VeriVide manufacture DigiEye, the digital all LED colour measurement and imaging system designed to measure colour and appearance of product using a non-contact and non-destructive method. The system offers definitive objective results and enables global communication of product colour data together with the image.  

VeriVide are the official master distributors of Pantone, RAL and NCS colour standards in the UK and are the sole UK stockist of Pantone Cotton Swatch cards. We also offer colour training courses and colour vision testing with our colour experts.

Posts do not necessarily reflect the views of partner companies.

Name: Mirion Technologies UK
Description:
Mirion Technologies UK is a leading provider of innovative products, systems and services related to the detection, measurement and monitoring of radiation. For over 60 years, we have worked alongside customers to develop and deliver high-quality cutting-edge solutions to the most difficult radiation safety, measurement, and characterisation challenges. 

We also provide a range of imaging systems for inspection, surveillance and monitoring for high temperature industries such as cement, pulp and paper, power generation (gas, coal and oil), steel, glass, petrochemical and waste incineration (hightemp.mirion.com). 

Our UK presence comprises offices in Harwell, Farnborough, Warrington, Seascale and Forss.

Mirion Technologies is a division of Mirion; our global organisation comprises over 2,800 talented professionals delivering world-class products, services, and solutions.

Name: Lucy Zodion Limited
Description:
Switched on street lighting

Over 50 years’ experience in the design and manufacture of street lighting solutions...
Lucy Zodion is a leader in the design and manufacture of street lighting equipment in the UK, supplying to countries throughout Europe, Australasia, Africa, the Far and Middle East. With a product range spanning on-street lighting installation, electrical distribution and control, our industry prominence has been afforded through years of experience and a dedication to innovation in the products and services we offer. 
 
We’re committed to developing tomorrow’s solutions, today...
Committed to developing futureproof street lighting and power distribution solutions, our key focus is providing a clear package that can meet and exceed the growing needs of connected and environmentally conscious communities across the world.
 
As the impetus of energy efficiency and data management grows, street lighting as we know it is transforming from illumination hardware into a valuable digital urban asset. Used to facilitate a number of smart solutions that help enrich communities, the connected lamppost has been realised as an integral factor for smarter, more responsive cities. This, alongside the integration of IoT, means streetlights are ever evolving as pivotal features throughout urban areas, providing citizens and councils alike with enhanced more intuitive services.
 
Lucy Zodion’s next generation solutions harness IoT technology to make unique urban data more accessible and secure. Our vision is to unlock the potential of tomorrow’s cities with a smart, open and sustainable ecosystem that truly benefits the community. This can be achieved through interoperable smart city networks that enable forward thinking city leaders to take control of their urban infrastructure, both today and tomorrow.

Name: Anglia
Description:
Anglia Components Plc is the UK’s leading independent authorised distributor of semiconductors, optoelectronics, interconnect, passive and electromechanical components. A signatory of the ADS SC21 programme, the company holds AS9120, ISO9001 & ISO14001 accreditations.

Anglia is driven by an ethos of ever-improving customer understanding and, as a privately-owned business, aims to provide a fast, consistent and highly responsive service.

Name: Bells Power Group Ltd
Description:
Bells Power Group Ltd was established in the city of London in 1898, and operate from their own offices in the EC2 area, undertaking high quality commercial and industrial generator and UPS power Installations. 

With over 125 years of experience, Bells Power Group has become one of the most trusted names in the design and off site fabrication, supply, installation and servicing of generator sets across the UK nationwide and international. 

We not only provide excellent quality diesel and gas generator sets, we also offer expert advice, specialist technical support, installation, mechanical electrical services, maintenance and parts. 

Working closely with architects and consulting engineers, we deliver both generator and UPS power systems at competitive prices. We are known for our design and installation expertise and the highest levels of customer service from concept to completion.

We understand that every client and every project is unique. This is our starting point with every project, ensuring the delivery of the most appropriate products and solutions.

Name: Easby Electronics
Description:
We are the bridge between you and a global network of top-tier electronic component suppliers.

Every day we discover different, complex, needs that compel us to listen and understand. We’re flexible, we adapt, and create different solutions designed around you. We deliver supply chain improvements, faster, making you more efficient and cost effective.

Part of the Easby Group:

Name: Custom Power
Description:

With dedicated production facilities across the USA and Europe, utilizing the latest engineering processes and equipment, Custom Power is positioned at the forefront of international battery technology manufacturing.

We specialize in primary and secondary battery power systems for critical medical, aerospace, defense, energy and industrial applications. Our products employ a range of cell chemistries, complex control electronics and custom enclosures, ensuring the perfect fit for each application.

Our processes consistently meet and exceed the most stringent requirements put in place by the various industries and clients we serve. Custom Power maintains ISO9001:2015, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and AS9100 certifications, RoHS compliance, and ITAR registration.

Name: Securi-Flex Ltd
Description:
Securi-Flex is a leading manufacturing partner and distributor of specialist cables and accessories, dedicated to the electrical and security wholesale market. We have developed exclusive relationships with our preferred manufacturing partners and are industry renowned for our focus on product quality, depth of range and service.

Our customers are at the core of our business and values, and our vast range of specialist cables and accessories support a range of industries and applications. This has accelerated the growth and popularity of the Securi-Flex brands, which carry a 25-year warranty across the range.

Founded in 1998, and with over 20 years of experience, Securi-Flex has grown to become a leading supplier of specialist cables across the United Kingdom and Ireland.

Throughout Securi-Flex’s history, our focus has been on quality, depth of range and service, ensuring we meet the needs and requirements of our customers and the market, and delivering product and service solutions which excel.

Our route to market is, and has always been the electrical wholesale industry, supporting and servicing National Wholesalers, Buying Groups, Independent Wholesalers and Specialist Security Distributors across the United Kingdom and Ireland.

With circa 40,000 square feet of warehouse, office and distribution space, supporting over 2,000+ customers across the United Kingdom and Ireland means sourcing the Securi-Flex brand and products couldn’t be easier.

Securi-Flex has more than 1,300+ products across a variety of cable types and accessories, and with one of the UK’s largest stock holdings, we are confident that our depth and breadth of range provides a variety of solutions for a vast spectrum of industry applications and customer needs.

Name: LPA GROUP Plc
Description:
LPA Group plc (AIM: LPA) is an innovation-led engineering specialist in electronic and electro-mechanical components and systems. Focused on transport (rail and aviation), aerospace, defence, infrastructure and industrial markets and supplying into hostile and challenging environments, LPA is known for engineering solutions to improve product reliability, reducing maintenance and life cycle costs. 

The Group has four sites across the UK, selling to customers in the UK and overseas. Three of these are design and manufacturing sites: Saffron Walden, Essex - electro-mechanical systems for rail, aviation and industrial; Knapwell, Cambridge – power supplies for the rail market, Normanton, Yorkshire - LED lighting and electronic systems for rail and infrastructure. The fourth site is Newbury, Berkshire - value-added distribution of engineered components for rail, aerospace and defence. 

With over 160 years of UK design and manufacture, and with origins in the first ever light installed in 'Electric Avenue', Brixton; innovation is core to LPA and to the products and services supplied to our customers worldwide.

Name: Extronics Ltd.

From its UK headquarters, Extronics serves customers worldwide and, since its acquisition in 2023, has become BARTEC’s UK production site and centre of excellence for the Connectivity & IoT range of products and services.

SMART, SAFE & CONNECTED

Our equipment that's certified safe to use in ATEX, IECEx, and North American NEC 500/505 hazardous areas and fully rugged to withstand industrial use.

Name: Canford Audio Limited
Description:
Canford Audio - The Essential Source since 1976
 
Few names are as synonymous with the industry as Canford. In 1976, Iain Elliott (the driving force behind Canford) had the simple idea of creating a one-stop shop for everything needed for broadcast infrastructure and, thus, the 'Essential Source' was born.
 
As the company has grown over the decades, we have explored new avenues and ventures (including our custom metalwork manufacturing plant in Portland, Dorset) as well as merging Panamic, Tecpro, EMO and NEAL into the Canford Group. Our huge, and ever-expanding, product portfolio boasts around 20,000 carefully selected lines from more than 225 brands, all of which cater for broadcast, live events, pro AV, and many other industry sectors.
 
We've had the privilege of assisting hundreds of thousands of customers over the years; whether on our doorstep or based on a remote island, a member of the FTSE 100 or an individual contractor, ordering miles of custom-built fibre cable or a single ready-made connector. The reason behind this? All of our customers receive the same exceptional level of customer service that Canford has become renowned for. To better assist our overseas customers, we also have regional offices in Strasbourg (France), and Dubai (UAE).
 
In 2019, Canford was transferred to an Employee Ownership Trust to be run for the long-term benefit of all present and future employees. The Canford Group continues to operate under the same guiding principles that we always have, which also guarantees a significant workforce based in the North East of England.
 
In late 2021, Iain Elliott sadly passed away. And so it is up to us, the Canford employees, to build on his vision and to continue his legacy. Simple ideas can change everything.

Name: Heat Trace Limited
Description:
Heat Trace Limited (HTL) is an innovative British manufacturer of electric heating cables & associated equipment.  Founded in 1974 the company is now considered to be the technological leader in the field of electric heat tracing systems.  

Offering an extensive range of self-regulating & constant power output heating cables, products are used extensively in the Oil/Gas & Petrochemical industries both onshore & offshore.  Products & systems are also provided for use in many other industries such as: Power Generation (conventional & nuclear); Water & Waste Treatment; Food Processing; Chemical & Pharmaceutical, as well as many other industries. HTL recently completed the world’s first subsea, electrically heat traced, reeled pipe-in-pipe system in partnership with Technip UK for TOTAL E&P”.

In addition to products & systems manufacture, services offered include consultancy, system design, installation and commissioning, project management, system maintenance and personnel training.

HTL is an innovative company, Investing 15% of turnover into R&D.  This enables the company to ensure that its broad product range is the most technologically advanced, offering its customers the highest power outputs, maximum withstand temperatures and longest circuit lengths.  Since its inception over 50 years ago, Heat Trace has been " .....setting the standards ..... and leading the way".

Name: Rosahl solid state dehumidifiers
Description:
Equipment failure due to moisture damage has major cost implications for OEMS and machine builders but is easily avoided.

Installing electric micro-dehumidifiers protects sensitive equipment from moisture damage both during and after warranty. They protect your brand and reputation, and avoidable warranty call-outs. When a customer’s machine fails, financial consequences include lost production and sales, scrap materials and wasted energy.

For the OEM, it involves service visits, replacement parts, claims for losses and contract penalties. Worse, can be a damaged reputation, customer confidence and the loss of future orders.

Developed by a leading global manufacturer, Rosahl is an electric micro-dehumidifier. It protects sensitive electronics and photonics from moisture and condensation damage. It uses a compact solid polymer electrolyte (SPE) membrane for long-term maintenance-free drying. It is suitable for a enclosure volumes from 250 ml up to 4m3 (140 cu ft).

TML’s core skill is marine data management.  We collect data from multiple sources, bring it all to one place and then process it to provide useful information to the user.  Over the past 10 years we have developed a range of hardware and software solutions for ocean monitoring buoys, where systems are deployed for months at a time with no possibility of external support.

Latterly we have taken this experience and focussed it on vessel data monitoring.  Our most recent successes have been in hybrid marine propulsion management, whole vessel energy management and remote performance monitoring.

Hybrid propulsion requires in depth monitoring of all of the vessel’s diverse systems in order to make them function efficiently as a single operational unit.  This is TML’s home ground, “listening” to the engines, motors, batteries, power electronics and navigational systems and presenting the data as a single coherent whole.  Our skill is converting complex data streams into useful information from which management and control then flow.

Energy management is an integral part of hybrid systems but also stands alone regardless of the propulsion type.  TML captures and visualises the energy flows in the vessel and then uses cost and operational requirements to make choices about which energy source to use and which consumers to prioritise.
Delivering information to the end user is the final piece of the puzzle.  Whether it is by wi-fi, radio, mobile phone or satellite, we have the technology to deliver your information wherever you need it.

Whether it is a buoy or a vessel, whether you are at sea or in your office, our systems make sure that you know exactly what is happening as it happens.

Description:

This includes having pride in SEM and its products; taking responsibility and making decisions on a day to day basis; approaching challenges with a positive mind-set; engaging with everyone with respect; promoting safety and wellbeing of all our colleagues; and continually striving for excellence.

Name: DJB Instruments
Description:
DJB Instruments UK Ltd has been a trusted name in vibration sensing since 1974, when it was founded as DJ Birchall Ltd. Today, we continue to design and manufacture a wide range of IEPE and charge accelerometers, cables, instrumentation and accessories from our UK headquarters in Mildenhall, Suffolk.

With our own CNC machine shop, cable assembly area and accredited calibration laboratory, we offer full control over the entire production process, from initial design through to dispatch. We’re proud to uphold the traditions of quality British manufacturing, combining precision engineering with continuous innovation.

DJB is the only accelerometer manufacturer in the world using the patented Konic ShearTM design, which provides excellent performance with significantly reduced cross-axis error. Our product range includes several industry firsts, including ultra-high temperature IEPE accelerometers rated up to 185°C, water-cooled triaxial sensors capable of testing up to 900°C, and the world’s smallest IEPE accelerometer, weighing just 0.19 grams.

Many of our standard products are available from stock and are dispatched within 48 hours.

In 2021, DJB became part of the Condition Monitoring Technology Group (CMTG), a collaborative group of engineering companies specialising in advanced sensing, test and analysis solutions. Being part of CMTG has opened up new opportunities for joint R&D, academic partnerships and in-house material development.

CMTG includes:

Beran Instruments and Helitune (Torrington, North Devon)

Prosig (Fareham, Hampshire)

Semia (near Paris, France)

SEI (Chicago, USA)

Additional facilities in Munich, Germany

Together, CMTG designs, manufactures and supports world-class condition monitoring and test and measurement solutions for the aviation, power generation, automotive, advanced engineering, defence and manufacturing industries.

Name: Metway Electrical Industries Ltd
Description:
Wiring and lighting control shouldn’t slow a project down. Metway delivers specification-led wiring systems and DALI lighting control solutions for commercial buildings, from design through to commissioning.

Metway acts as a technical partner and one-stop shop for wiring, connectors and lighting control. We take a design and value-engineer it, improving efficiency, and protecting compliance without compromising performance.

As a long-standing UK manufacturer, Metway combines engineering heritage with modern wiring and lighting control platforms for commercial projects. DC Power Supplies
A power supply is often taken for granted as it is seen as an insignificant part of equipment. For most it is just an electronic box ordered at the last moment. However, a power supply can be compared to our heart; It’s often neglected and we tend to pay more attention to our hair. Yet if the heart fails, the system goes down.

Design concept
Delta power supplies have a reputation of being remarkably reliable. Therefore our design concept puts a strong emphasis on long lifetime and excellent technical specifications. The specifications of our products may seem unrealistic at first, but when measured they turn out to be even better as defined. Delta users expect perfection, an almost infinite life time at continuous full power and low cost of ownership. Ongoing research makes it possible to produce products that can meet these ever increasing demands.

Result
As a result of our design philosophy the units react more than 10 times faster on load transients, produce hardly audible noise and produce 10 – 30 times less electromagnetic interference. Delta customers will never face any problems due to radiated or conducted emissions of our power supplies. The same design philosophy applies for immunity: the toughest standard is not good enough for us. A Delta power supply will always operate reliable, even in a very noisy environment.All our power supply units are thoroughly tested before being dispatched to the customer.This ensures long term correct functioning of each unit and client satisfaction. Delta Elektronika produces world class DC power supplies.

Each year, the average GivEnergy customer saves 85% on their energy bills, and reduces their carbon emissions by 300kg. Lastly we do so with high integrity around GDPR standards, we ensure data security by storing data at rest and in transit all in the UK. 
We believe our everyday choices might a difference to reduce our impact on the environment and we trust our products help powering the Future, One Home at a Time. Name: LEDFlex Group
Description:
Mission:
We manufacture well-engineered linear lighting systems that integrate with the dynamic demands of today’s market.

Vision:
To be globally recognised for sustainable premium linear lighting systems that inspire creativity while raising the benchmark for customer service excellence.

About us:
At LEDFlex Group, we are not just lighting manufacturers, we collaborate with lighting designers to transcend boundaries and turn visionary concepts into tangible realities. Bespoke brilliance is our hallmark. Specialising in premium linear LED solutions built with cutting-edge technology, we tailor our products to meet the unique requirements of each project.

However, our commitment extends far beyond the product. Supported by our in-house team of engineers and technical experts, we are able to offer comprehensive support throughout your entire journey, from design and installation guidance to after-sales support. Our global network further ensures seamless support wherever your project takes you.

From architectural and urban to residential and commercial, LEDFlex is the ultimate solution for any application. While we continuously push the boundaries of efficiency and reliability in our products, our true purpose lies in indulging our clients with creativity and inspiration. Collaborate with us to engineer extraordinary lighting experiences that not only illuminate spaces but also leave a lasting impression.

Name: PCB Piezotronics, Inc.
Description: PCB manufactures vibration, pressure, force, strain, shock, and acoustic sensors used by design engineers and predictive maintenance professionals worldwide for test, measurement, monitoring, and control requirements. Our sensors support testing in aerospace and defense, automotive, transportation, civil engineering, and general R&D industries. Primary sensing technologies include piezoelectric (ICP), piezoresistive, and capacitive MEMS. With a worldwide customer support team, 24-hour SensorLine, and a global distribution network, PCB is committed to Total Customer Satisfaction. PCB Piezotronics is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Amphenol Corporation.

Name: NAPIT
Description:
We are NAPIT.

We're a fast-growing government-approved and UKAS-accredited membership scheme operator in the building services and fabric sector. 

For further details about the scope of the NAPIT UKAS accreditation, please visit the UKAS website .

With over 20,000 registered installers across the UK, we serve the electrical, heating, plumbing, ventilation, microgeneration, and building fabric trades in domestic, commercial, and industrial markets.

Committed to raising standards and safety with a friendly, common-sense approach, we operate our membership schemes through NAPIT Registration and NAPIT Certification.

Our best in their field technical experts sit on a wide range of influential industry committees, including BSI/IET Wiring Regulation Committee JPEL/64 and Sub Committee A and B, BSI committees, EAS Management Committee, Electrical Safety Roundtable and Electrical Safety First Technical Committee.

Extensive events schedule with our own NAPIT EXPO’s (or NAPIT EXPO Zones within ELEX), as well as appearing as regular technical speakers and panelists at ELEX Tool Fair, ETT Stay Connected and InstallerSHOW.  

The NAPIT Group spans across many different services, some of these being:

The NAPIT|Shop – Home of our helpful on-site tools, member branded workwear, and to a wide variety of informative and supportive publications, including our own award-winning publications written by our technical experts. 

NAPIT|Training – Approved training centres across the UK, with all training certified or accredited by City & Guilds, BPEC, LCL awards, NCFE or EAL.

 NAPIT|FastTest – Our in-house advanced, multi-platform electrical installation, inspection & testing, fire, gas and ventilation certification software.  

With many other services provided as benefits to our members only.

Name: Innovative Technology Ltd
Description:
For more than thirty years we have been at the forefront of innovation in transaction automation.

We have two main divisions: cash handling equipment and AI-powered biometric solutions.

Established as a leading provider of cash handling equipment we enable customers to automate cash payments throughout the world; manufacturing multi-coin hoppers, banknote validators and recyclers that handle millions of transactions every day for some of the world’s leading companies.

This desire to continually innovate has led to the development of our AI powered biometric solutions division. Using facial analysis to intelligently identify people more efficiently and securely, our solutions allow customers to easily add age estimation and access control functionality to their existing equipment or premises.

As an innovation-led global technology company, we research and develop a broad range of products that reduce operational costs and maximise efficiency for the gaming, retail, kiosk, amusement and vending markets.  We have a reputation for excellence in developing products that improve the customer experience and that are affordable, reliable and responsive to both business and customer needs in a rapidly changing world.

We have a growing international presence with commercial operations across the globe, two manufacturing sites, a rapidly expanding R&D centre and a network of over 20 trading partners.

Name: HOPPECKE Batteries
Description:
HOPPECKE - your expert for industrial batteries & energy storage solutions

The availability and securing of electricity is one of the key requirements of our society and at the same a challenge for our times.  

That is where we believe we can make a contribution: with the development of marketable, future-oriented energy storage solutions for numerous areas of application, we help to develop, among other things, the expansion of electrical energy supply from regenerative energy sources, enable stable grids and promote digitalization and automation.

HOPPECKE operates internationally, but is still close to its customers, because in addition to our headquarters in Brilon-Hoppecke in Germany, we are represented in 150 countries by 23 international subsidiaries and numerous representative offices and partners. 50 percent of DAX companies and 40 percent of Euro Stoxx50 companies are HOPPECKE customers. With more than 2,000 employees, we are the largest privately owned manufacturer of industrial battery systems in Europe. 

HOPPECKE has been run as a family business since 1927. In addition to innovation and continuous improvement of our products, the values of holistic responsibility and cooperation in a spirit of partnership are of paramount importance to us.

Today, we serve four main application areas with our products and solutions: Energy storage solutions for traction systems (trak), energy storage solutions for a secure power supply (grid), energy storage solutions for renewable energies (sun) and energy storage solutions for railway and metro systems (rail). 

All four fields of application are supported by HOPPECKE Service and its comprehensive range of services. 

With more than 90 years of experience, our company develops and produces energy storage systems to uniform standards worldwide. 

Learn more about us and our products and give us new challenges.

Name: Anord Mardix
Description:
Anord Mardix, a Flex company, is the global leader in critical power distribution and protection. We lead through engineering excellence, driving quality, sustainability and innovation through our comprehensive product range and service offering. We work with our clients to build relationships focused on bespoke end-to-end solutions, unrivalled in the critical power industry. 

Our operational and manufacturing facilities reach globally across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific employing over 1,000 highly skilled people in a comprehensive and diverse range of roles. We have the strongest leadership team in the industry, driving progress, encouraging curiosity and empowering our employees to reach their full potential. 

From a story founded by two family-owned business, to now operating as a Flex-owned company. Anord Mardix has seen rapid growth as it now leads the critical power industry. Acquired in 2021, Anord Mardix is part of the Industrial business unit of Flex a $24 billion diversified manufacturer with more than 160,000 employees worldwide. Offering a strong balance sheet, a worldwide supply chain and extensive distribution network, Flex’s 100 manufacturing sites across 30 countries, allow Anord Mardix to leverage unparalleled scalability, growth and reliability. 

We invest in resources; people, machinery, facilities and innovation. In tomorrow’s world, Anord Mardix will shape the infrastructure essential to all forms of digital development.

Name: Cicor Group
Description: Cicor is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced electronic solutions. Serving the healthcare technology, industrial electronics and aerospace & defence sectors, our full-cycle approach combines engineering excellence with high-precision production to bring ideas to life. Together with our customers, we create electronics that make the world a healthier, more connected and safer place.

Name: PULS Group
Description:
PULS is Europe’s biggest manufacturer of industrial DC power solutions and a global technology leader for reliable power supplies for demanding applications. Our solutions serve critical systems in factory and process automation, intralogistics, medical/life science, semiconductor industry, data centers, energy and automotive.

Since 1980, PULS has been driven by engineering excellence, innovation and customer value. We develop DC power solutions with superior reliability, highest efficiency and long-term operational security, helping customers reduce downtime, lower energy and maintenance costs and build reliable systems for years.

PULS has its roots in DIN rail power supplies, the area that shaped our company and laid the foundation for our success. Building on this expertise, we have grown into a global player with a broad portfolio. As a corporate group with Adelsystem and Wiferion, we offer a full DC power ecosystem: DIN rail power supplies, field power, DC backup solutions, wireless charging for AGVs and AMRs, and value-added services. This product universe opens new markets and application areas for industrial power solutions.

With around 1,400 employees worldwide, 350+ standard products, strong R&D capabilities and a resilient global production network, PULS supports customers and partners worldwide. We manufacture in Chomutov, Czech Republic, Suzhou, China, Chennai, India, and Germany.

As a self-financed, technology-driven company, PULS combines long-term thinking with a developer mindset. We value sustainability, quality and efficiency and empower customers to focus on performance, innovation and growth.

Contact: https://www.pulspower.com/contact/puls-worldwide/
Career: https://www.pulspower.com/company/career/job-opportunities/

Name: Ansell Lighting
Description:
With more than 30 years in the lighting industry Ansell is a recognised market leader in the design and manufacture of high quality luminaries for the commercial, domestic, industrial and architectural markets.

We focus exclusively on design, product quality and reliability, supported by a fast, efficient service to all of our customers.

Continuous investment in design, technology and infrastructure ensures excellent stock availability, product reliability and professional after sales technical support.

Our dynamic in-house design team has placed us at the forefront of LED lighting, enabling us to deliver our extensive range of LED lights for the Display, Amenity, Commercial, Floodlighting, Industrial and Emergency lighting markets.

Name: Luceco Group
Description:
Luceco Group is a global business that manufactures and distributes high-quality and innovative LED lighting products, EV Chargers, Electrical Wiring Devices and Accessories, Circuit Protection, Portable Power solutions, and Audio-Visual / Home Entertainment products worldwide. Offering our customers ‘Everything under one roof’ for any sector including trade, retail, independent, online and many more.

Our reputation is based on the reliability, sustainability, innovation and functionality of our products. By offering market-leading guarantees and warranties, technical support, dedicated customer service and marketing backup, we aim to make it easy for customers to specify and install sustainable lighting.

We are fully committed to improving environmental performance across all of our manufacturing and other business activities, continually looking for new methods and materials to provide environmentally friendly solutions. 

The teams behind Luceco Group group have over 100 years of combined lighting and electrical industry experience.

The Luceco Group brands include Luceco Lighting (LED Lighting), BG Electrical (Wiring Accessories), BG SyncEV (EV Chargers), Masterplug (Portable Power), Ross (AV Accessories) DW Windsor and Kingfisher (Exterior Lighting & Accessories).

Name: Raymarine
Description:
Teledyne Raymarine, a world leader in marine electronics, develops and manufactures the most comprehensive range of electronic equipment for the recreational boating and light commercial marine markets. Designed for high performance and ease of use, the award-winning products are available through a global network of dealers and distributors. 

The Raymarine product lines include radar, autopilots, GPS, instruments, fishfinders, communications, and integrated systems. Headquartered in Portsmouth UK, Raymarine is a division of Teledyne FLIR. For more information about Raymarine please go to  www.raymarine.com

About Teledyne FLIR 
Teledyne FLIR, a Teledyne Technologies company, is a world leader in intelligent sensing solutions for defense and industrial applications with approximately 4,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 1978, the company creates advanced technologies to help professionals make better, faster decisions that save lives and livelihoods. For more information, please visit www.teledyneflir.com

Name: Carlo Gavazzi Automation
Description:
Carlo Gavazzi is an international group engaged in the design, manufacturing, and marketing of electronic control components for the global building and industrial automation markets.

Its factories in Italy, Mexico, Lithuania, Malta, and China are certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 standards. 

The company’s product portfolio—including sensors, solid-state relays, energy meters and analyzers, IoT energy management systems, monitoring relays, soft starters, timers, power supplies, and safety devices—delivers comprehensive automation solutions for both industrial and building applications. 

Typical customers include original equipment manufacturers in sectors such as access control, agriculture, conveyors, distributed energy resources, energy efficiency, energy storage, EV charging infrastructure, food & beverage, HVAC, mobile equipment, plastics & rubber, and semiconductors. In addition, system integrators and distributors play a key role as effective market channels. 

Carlo Gavazzi markets its products worldwide through 23 wholly owned sales companies and approximately 60 independent national distributors, covering Europe, the Americas, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Name: Riello UPS
Description:
RIELLO UPS is one of the leading European company for single and three phases UPS on the range from 400 VA to 6400 kVA.

Riello UPS part of  the Riello Elettronica Group
Backed by 20 year’s experience, Riello Elettronica is the parent of a group of companies which operate in a number of sectors, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Automation, Sensors, Domotics.
Its business is focussed on the conversion of energy for industrial and civil applications. It is the European leader in the production of UPS systems (Uninterruptible Power Supply) under the brand name of Riello UPS. These systems guarantee the continuous supply of power to computers, electromedical and industrial equipment and radar and telecommunication systems. Riello Elettronica also operates in the automation and industrial and home security sector alongside international partners such as AVS Electronics, Telcoma Automation, Innovatech Sweethome and Ceimu.

The objective of RIELLO UPS is to supply global solutions that guarantee power quality; through R&D investments and the manufacture of resilient and efficient products.
Power Quality can be defined using two parameters:
• Continuity - guaranteeing a stable and secure electrical supply
• Quality - in terms of frequency, voltage, waveform and energy efficiency
Riello UPS provides value added in the form of Power Quality – its extensive product range guarantees that the company has an energy solution for any critical application.

Agile and adaptive engineering solutions and engineered products designed to future-proof critical infrastructure, address grid-resilience and drive system change, while supporting the drive to net-zero.

Drawing on over 100 years of expertise, Helvar’s solutions play an instrumental role in the transition to a more sustainable built environment, and can be found in projects all around the world spanning from hospitals, schools and workplaces to cruise ships, airports and stadiums. 

Helvar serves its customers locally with offices in Finland, UK, Poland and Sweden and via a global network of 85+ Partners around the world. To learn more, please visit helvar.com.

Name: MVG | Microwave Vision Group
Description:
The Microwave Vision Group offers cutting-edge technologies for the visualization of electromagnetic waves. With advanced test solutions for antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements, we support company R&D teams in their drive to innovate and boost product development.

Our solutions include:

•	MV-ScanTM technology: electronically-scanned multi-probe arrays
•	Antenna, RCS, radome & EMC measurement systems
•	Turnkey anechoic chambers
•	StarMIMOTM: MIMO testing systems
•	Antennas & probes
•	Wireless device measurement & certification, including SAR & HAC
•	Measurement software
•	RF safety  monitors and other applications 
•	RF absorbers
•	EMC shielded chambers 

With highly skilled teams across the world and over 450 dedicated employees, we proudly serve the telecommunications, aerospace&defence, automotive, academic and research communities.

Over a period of more than 30 years, MVG has unified the skills of four industry leaders (Satimo, Orbit/FR, Rainford EMC, AEMI).

Together, under one unified brand, we tackle some of the world’s most complex electromagnetic wave visualisation challenges.

Name: Thorlux Lighting
Description:
Innovating sustainable lighting solutions for a brighter future.

Thorlux Lighting is a globally recognised manufacturer of luminaires and lighting control systems.

Headquartered in Worcestershire, UK, its modern 16,882 m2 factory is just a few miles from where Frederick William Thorpe first manufactured Thorlux luminaires in 1936. Thorlux proudly manufactures over 90% of its products in the Midlands, employing over five hundred people locally.

Thorlux is a complete lighting solutions partner, a single point of contact for luminaires, controls, design, installation, and more. Sustainability and environmental care are written in the organisation’s DNA, with a 2040 net-zero greenhouse gas emissions target.

As part of the FW Thorpe Plc Group, Thorlux remains family-driven, with the Thorpe family actively involved in the organisation. Nearly ninety years after its foundation, Thorlux remains at the forefront of efficient, high-quality lighting technology.

Name: LEMO GROUP
Description:
With a history of eight decades of excellence and innovation, the LEMO Group is a global leader in high-performance interconnection solutions.

From the depths of the oceans to space, from the freezing North Pole to the burning heart of jet engines, from operating theatres to car races, we connect everything that must not be accidentally disconnected.

Do you want to make a better future? With us, you will develop world-renowned solutions. With us, you will help technological leaders push back the limits of science, medicine, robotics, communication, transport, and energy.

Name: Besomi Group
Description:
Welcome to Besomi Electronics Group.

Besomi Electronics Group is one of the leading suppliers of engineering spare parts in the region.

The group was born in Amman, Jordan on 1986 and expanded its operation to UAE, Dubai in 1998 which enabled the group to partner with world leading clients in different sectors such as oil & gas, industrial, education, communication, governmental sectors and more.

In 2020, The group reach another milestone after opening the office in Cairo, Egypt that will focus also the African continent.

VALUES

 Accuracy & Transparency.

Name: The Lighting Industry Association (The LIA)
Description:
The Lighting Industry Association (The LIA) is the United Kingdom’s leading trade Association representing the lighting sector and its supply chain. 

Guided by The C.A.S.E. for The LIA (Compliance, Advocacy, Sustainability, and Education) these four pillars define the Association’s purpose and demonstrate its ongoing commitment to members and the wider lighting community. The LIA badge is a recognised mark of quality, integrity, and technical excellence. Membership is earned through rigorous assessment, including entry audits, random product evaluations, and ongoing reviews to ensure the highest standards are upheld across an ever-changing marketplace. LIA Membership and Certification signify trust, assurance, and excellence in lighting solutions. 

BE PART OF IT.

Name: Fischer Connectors
Description:
Founded in 1954, Fischer Connectors designs, develops and deploys end-to-end interconnect solutions for ecosystems requiring local transfer and management of data, signals and power. Its tailored electronic solutions, connectors and cable assemblies are trusted globally for their reliability in demanding environments.

The company is part of the Swiss-headquartered technology group Conextivity. With 800+ employees worldwide, 1 R&D center located in Switzerland and supported by regional hubs, 3 main manufacturing sites and a network of partners, and 2 business activities (Fischer Connectors and Wearin'), Conextivity Group offers high-performance connectivity solutions that manage power and data flows seamlessly from sensors and devices to the cloud and AI, enabling the emergence of new transverse and scalable ecosystems.

Fischer Connectors’ products and solutions are tested to MIL-SPEC & IEC standards, and compliant with RoHS and REACH. They use the latest technologies in ruggedness, sealing, high-density miniaturization & data transmission for demanding, harsh-environment application fields such as defense & security, medical, robotics, automation, sensors and test & measurement. ISO 13485:2016 certified, Fischer Connectors manufactures quality products that are safe and reliable for integration into medical devices.

Fischer Connectors provides customers with:
- Standard or tailored solutions with dedicated technical support, consulting, system-level engineering, simulation and testing
- High responsiveness, fast prototyping and unrivalled lead times and customer service 
- IP68/IP69 sealing & hermeticity
- Weight optimization, high density, miniaturization
- Signal integrity, high-speed data transmission
- Cable assembly capabilities from design drawings, proofs of concept, prototypes to industrialized solutions
- Dedicated, pioneering electronic development from initial evaluation and proof of concept to design, industrial supply and life cycle management

Name: Optoma
Description:
Experience more.

With customer needs and the user experience at the centre of everything we do, Optoma’s projection, LED and interactive flat panel display products combine superior image processing technologies with exceptional engineering and innovation to deliver stunning crystal clear images with ultimate reliability.

Name: C-TEC
Description:
C-TEC is a leading UK manufacturer of world-class life-safety systems including open-protocol fire detection and fire alarm systems, fire IoT systems, evacuation alert systems, call systems, disabled refuge systems and hearing assistance systems. 

Established in 1981, many of our products are third-party certificated by internationally recognised test and approval bodies such as the LPCB, the BSI, Intertek and the VdS, confirming to specifiers, installers and consumers alike that they meet the design and performance requirements of key British, European and international standards.

Name: Hager UK
Description:
Coming from humble beginnings, two brothers, Herman and Oswald Hager had the ambitious dream of shaping the future of the electrical industry in a way that provided individuals with a safer, cleaner and a more enjoyable tomorrow. Name: Riello UPS Ltd
Description:
Riello UPS Ltd is a leader in the manufacture of uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) from 400 VA to 6.4 MVA and standby generators from 8 kVA to 2.5 MVA.

We enable reliable power for a sustainable world by offering products that combine engineering excellence and quality performance with exceptional energy efficiency. 

Our award-winning range incorporates solutions powering the smallest desktop PCs through to the latest data centre supercomputers. Riello UPS products protect power for high-profile businesses leading sectors as diverse as manufacturing, finance, retail, healthcare, and telecommunications.

As part of the Riello Elettronica group, Riello UPS is an official sponsor and partner of the Ducati Corse MotoGP and Aruba.it Racing World Superbike Championship motorcycle racing teams.

Name: Click Scolmore

Since our incorporation in 1989 we have become a significant force in the electrical accessory market. We’re proud to be a British based, family-run business, with an excellent track record of listening to what our customers need and providing the right solution every time.
