JLEC Electrical are not only committed to providing customers with a high level of quality and satisfaction. We also take pride in taking on apprentices from school and provide quality ‘in house’ training which helps them to become fully qualified electricians and further their careers. We work closely with local training organisations to ensure that school leavers obtain the best possible training. Along with the electrical training provided by these training organisations. JLEC Electrical gives training to there apprentices within the other areas of work that we cover. 

JLEC Electrical are committed to Health and Safety at work. It is our priority that all tasks are carried out with the strict implementation of the Health and Safety at work act.  JLEC Electrical are CHAS registered. We are also members of the NICEIC which is the electrical contracting industry’s independent voluntary body for electrical installation matters throughout the UK. Our NICEIC enrolment number is 22126. 

Our range of expertise gives us the capability to design, build and complete installations ranging from 11KV (High Voltage) supplies down to voice/data instalments.

We carry out all areas of electrical works including: Solar Panels, EV Chargers, Renwable Energy:

•    Industrial
•    Commercial
•    Retail
•    Lighting System
•    Voice/Data (CAT5e, CAT6 and Fibre Optics)
•    UPS (Uninterrupted Power Supply)
•    Generators
•    CCTV Systems
•    Door Access
•    Automated Gates
•    Fire Alarms
•    Emergency Lighting
•    Pat Testing

Name: Sécheron Hasler Group
Description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a leading global supplier of electrical and electronic safety components and solutions and traction power systems for the railway industry and also provides solutions for renewable energy, DC grid, and other industrial systems.

Headquartered in Switzerland, Sécheron Hasler Group is independent and privately-owned by a team of entrepreneurs committed to long-term sustainability through technological innovation, superior quality, and unrivalled customer service. We answer to you, our customers, first!

Our founding companies, Sécheron SA and HaslerRail AG, boast a 140-year history of innovation in the rail industry, pioneering railway technologies. Today, Sécheron Hasler Group draws on this extensive experience to develop and customize products and solutions compliant with local standards on markets worldwide.

Our Electrical Safety Solutions, Traction Power Systems and On-Board Electronics business units design and manufacture safety-critical electrical and electronic equipment for the rail, renewable energy, DC grid and other energy-intensive markets.

www.secheron.com

www.haslerrail.com

Name: Mastervolt
Description:
Mastervolt: The power to be independent

Mastervolt stands for reliable and innovative autonomous power solutions. As specialists in the management, conversion and storage of electrical energy, we offer a comprehensive product portfolio with a power range from 300 W to 40 kWatt. Our electric solutions are widely used in demanding markets such as marine, mobile, off shore, industrial, autonomous solar and infrastructure.

 Stronger together
Mastervolt is part of Power Products, LLC, which includes various leading brands within its Marine, Mobile & Industrial division. Ancor, BEP, Blue Sea Systems, CZone, Lenco, Marinco, Mastervolt and ProMariner provided innovative electrical solutions as independent companies for decades. Now these leading companies have come together to offer the broadest and most complete electrical product range for every conceivable application.

 Breakthrough technology, optimum performance
Mastervolt has been a strong, innovation-driven company since its founding in 1991. Product development takes place in three highly sophisticated R&D centres, in Amsterdam (The Netherlands), Auckland (New Zealand) and Wisconsin (USA), where our engineers are continuously searching for new ways to connect breakthrough technology with optimum performance.

 Superior service
This capacity to innovate is what truly sets Mastervolt apart. Our added value is to offer products, technologies and systems of the highest quality coupled with superior global service. The passion and commitment of our people make the difference.

 Driven by passion
We have a team of enthusiastic professionals on board. Our work culture is informal and straightforward. Everyone works with genuine commitment. Showing and pleasure are paramount. Those aspects and the opportunities to develop yourself in an international environment makes Mastervolt a great employer. We regularly offer new career opportunities; vacancies are on our website. We're happy to receive unsolicited applications

Name: Plessey Semiconductors Ltd
Description:
Plessey engineers the future in light.

We design and build photonic devices and systems that help our customers shape the future of computing.

Our work spans microLED displays and optical interconnects—technologies enabling faster, more efficient, and more scalable processing. Built on our proprietary GaN-on-Silicon platform, we combine research, IP, materials, process expertise, and manufacturing in one integrated operation.
From source to signal. Every stage connected.
This gives us control, precision, and the ability to take ideas from concept to scale.

From our Plymouth facility, we design, test, and manufacture advanced photonic technologies with deep technical expertise and proven capability. 

Our approach is grounded in three values:
Lead — We take ownership of complex challenges and engineer practical solutions.
Grow — We develop our technology, capability, and people with intent.
Trust — We deliver with consistency, transparency, and technical rigour.

Name: Basor Electric
Description:
La experiencia de BASOR ELECTRIC, S.A. a lo largo de sus más de 30 años en el sector de las instalaciones eléctricas industriales, la convierte en una empresa líder en la fabricación de sistemas de conducción de cables para grandes y pequeñas obras de ingeniería.
BASOR muestra su inquietud por la innovación haciendo un gran esfuerzo de inversión en el departamento de I+D+i, que junto con el departamento de ingeniería estudia cada caso hasta encontrar la solución más eficaz, ofreciendo al cliente los productos más avanzados del mercado, con la clara vocación de reducir costes de instalación. BASOR ELECTRIC posee diferentes patentes que afectan al diseño de las familias normalizadas.
Todos los productos se desarrollan bajo Normas Internacionales IEC, excepto en aquellos casos en los que el Comité Eléctrico Internacional no ha desarrollado la norma internacional, y por tanto los productos se desarrollan bajo normas europeas. Para proyectos basados en otras normativas no internacionales y distintas a las europeas (NEMA, ASTM, etc.), BASOR elabora documentación técnica sobre las equivalencias entre dichas normas y las europeas.
				
BASOR es una de las pocas empresas del sector de las canalizaciones eléctricas, que posee su propia Planta de Tratamientos Superficiales, donde se dan a los productos los acabados de galvanización en caliente, cincado y recubrimientos orgánicos.

Name: Tamlite Lighting
Description:
Tamlite Lighting is an award-winning UK lighting manufacturer founded 1967 in Telford, offering one of the broadest, strongest and most technically advanced product portfolios of any lighting manufacturer.

With 5 UK factories and continued investment into manufacturing processes, Tamlite offers luminaires that have been built with care, diligence and quality at its core. Tamlite’s dedicated luminaire design team understand the requirements of an ever-changing lighting market, and are always striving to develop luminaires that provide style and functionality. The luminaire design team also develops bespoke lighting solutions, meeting specific requirements set out by clients.

Tamlite’s rigorous testing facilities ensure that all products hit their standards in terms of light output, performance and efficacy.

Tamlite prides itself on delivering lighting solutions of the highest quality. This is backed up by the Lux Manufacturer of the Year and the Electrical Industry Project of the Year awards, both won in 2018. Tamlite was also the inaugural winner of the LIAQA Scheme in 2017.

Tamlite has a 30-strong LIA certified team of lighting engineers, completing lighting projects throughout a wide range of sectors and applications. This is backed up by the experienced Technical Department, providing exacting lighting designs, working with consultants, architects and designers to deliver outstanding specification projects.

With the ever-increasing need for sustainability in both products and processes, Tamlite launched a dedicated service, Tamlite Environmental. This promotes lighting solutions that adhere to the circular economy and offers an unparalleled recycling service for customers, to offer an end to end sustainable solution.

Accredited with both ICEL and BAFE certification, Tamlite excels within the emergency lighting market, manufacturing and delivering solutions that are both compliant and high performance.

Name: Monitra
Description:
Monitra (formerly HVPD) are experts in the field of Partial Discharge (PD) testing and monitoring of Medium Voltage and High Voltage electrical equipment, which can be performed on power cables, switchgear, transformers, motors and generators operating at 3.3 kV and above.

Our Partial Discharge PD test and monitoring systems help end users and operators to keep their production operations up and running, by providing the best early warning indicator of electrical insulation deterioration in medium and high voltage (MV/HV) networks.

The implementation of PD monitoring technology enables operators to improve plant efficiency, safety and reliability by minimising unplanned downtime and avoiding catastrophic failures.

Whether implemented at project start-up or end-of life extension, we support critical networks throughout the asset lifecycle to reduce consequence of failure.

Our Head Office, Manufacturing and Training Facility is based in Manchester and hosts a 100 kV Faraday Cage facility. As an international organisation we support our global customer with offices in Texas USA, Dalian China, UAE Middle East and Perth Western Australia as well as an extensive network of international channel partners.

Name: Astro Lighting
Description: Since 1997, Astro’s philosophy has been rooted in purposeful design and lasting quality. This approach informs a comprehensive range of modern lighting for hospitality, residential, senior living, and commercial spaces worldwide. Offering an extensive portfolio of architectural, and decorative interior, bathroom and exterior lighting, our collections are defined by simplicity, clean lines, and meticulous attention to detail. Crafted to perform and built to last, our designs offer a timeless aesthetic suited to contemporary interiors.

Name: Saab Seaeye
Description:
For over 30 years our systems have operated in some of the most hostile environments on the planet and to depths of nearly two miles below the surface of the world’s oceans.

Our pioneering technology has revolutionised the underwater robotics industry.

In turbulent waters and pitch darkness, these remarkable vehicles can undertake missions that would be impossible by any other means. Tasks that range from gathering fragile Roman pottery, to recovering torpedoes; and from filming bioluminescent creatures, to creating detailed 3D scans of dam structures.

Rapid advances in miniaturisation and intelligent control architecture are creating ever smaller and smarter robotic systems that are more agile and more powerful, and bring advanced technology to ever more complex tasks. 

Winning a worldwide reputation for creating highly sophisticated technology that is trusted to work at a diverse range of tasks in the most hazardous conditions is our proudest achievement.

Over 80 percent of our systems are exported across the globe and used in diverse sectors that include oil and gas, renewables, marine science, aquaculture, hydro engineering, undersea mining, salvage, telecoms, nuclear, leisure, emergency and defence.

Our parent company SAAB AB employs 14,000 people in over 30 countries.

Name: Kingfisher Lighting
Description:
Kingfisher Lighting | 35+ Years of Expertise in Tailored Exterior Lighting Solutions
For over 35 years, Kingfisher Lighting has been providing professional service and high-quality, bespoke lighting solutions to a wide range of clients, including wholesalers, contractors, specifiers, designers, local authorities, and end-users.

We specialise in various applications such as car parks, distribution and warehousing, road and street lighting, urban landscapes, transport, rail, high mast and flood lighting, and sports lighting. Whether you require a full-service solution or supply-only options, we are here to meet your specific needs.

Our commitment is to deliver practical, affordable, and reliable lighting technology. By utilising the latest in LED technologies, we ensure our products are developed with both innovation and customer requirements in mind.

Coordinated by our expert technical team, we design, develop, and manufacture our own luminaires, working alongside our exclusive specification lighting partners AEC Illuminazione and Arcluce. This collaboration brings the best of Italian lighting design and engineering to the UK market.

Name: Transformers & Rectifiers Ltd.
Description:
Transformers & Rectifiers Ltd is a globally recognised specialist in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of liquid-filled and dry-type transformers, as well as transformer rectifiers. As an independent British engineering company, we deliver world-class power solutions to customers across international markets.

With more than 75 years of engineering heritage, we have developed extensive technical expertise, advanced manufacturing capability, and a deep understanding of complex power applications. Our state-of-the-art facilities in Guildford, Surrey integrate in-house design, manufacturing, and comprehensive testing, ensuring full control over quality, performance, and compliance.

We offer one of the most comprehensive product ranges in the industry, supporting a wide spectrum of power transformer and rectifier applications. From standard designs to highly bespoke engineered solutions, we address demanding operational requirements with precision and flexibility.

Our products are recognised for their reliability, robustness, and efficiency. In addition to manufacturing excellence, we provide dedicated after-sales support and maintenance services, reinforcing our long-term commitment to customer performance and asset longevity.

We supply leading organisations worldwide, including blue-chip companies within the defence and infrastructure sectors, operating in some of the most challenging environments. In safety-critical applications, such as the UK railway industry, we hold sole approved supplier status.

Transformers & Rectifiers Ltd is certified to BS EN ISO 9001:2015, BS EN ISO 14001:2015, and BS EN ISO 45001:2018, reflecting our commitment to quality, environmental responsibility, and occupational health and safety.

Name: AVIRE
Description:
AVIRE delivers an extensive range of safety and communication products for lifts including light curtains, emergency telephones, connectivity solutions and displays. AVIRE products are installed in over four million buildings worldwide and are made up of market leading brands each with their own unique histories and specialties. A large part of our strength comes from our product brands (MEMCO, MICROKEY, RATH, and JANUS) each of which brings a wealth of knowledge and innovative technology to the table.

With manufacturing locations in Barcelona, the Czech Republic, and USA and sales offices in 7 locations across the globe; we believe that our global sales with local support approach gives our customers the high-quality product and hassle-free experience to easily maintain and modernize their lifts.

We are committed to providing quality products and solutions. With a dedicated focus on investing in our current portfolio we are also continuously looking to the future and listening to our customer’s needs in an ever-changing world.

Name: MOBA Mobile Automation
Description:
Welcome to the Official LinkedIn Channel of the MOBA Mobile Automation Group. 

For more than 40 years, MOBA has developed and manufactured custom components and application-oriented premium system solutions servicing the industries of road construction, earthmoving, waste / logistics and agriculture.
 
A leader in pioneering technology, applications and products, such as the PAVE-IR Scanner and Sonic-Ski.  MOBA excels at innovative product development, designed with a proactive and forward-thinking approach in mind. 

Our mission is to provide customers with reliable, accurate, and robust systems, sensors, controllers, and HMIs with a keen emphasis on dependability, allowing for every-day usage. 

As a global player, our customer base comes from around the globe, providing strong local support channels through our subsidiaries and dealers.
   
MOBA was founded in 1972 by engineer-entrepreneur Paul Harms, whose efforts set the solid foundation for the industry leader we are today.   MOBA proudly employs more than 500 people world-wide.

Name: Harwin
Description:
Founded in 1952, Harwin is a global manufacturer of high-reliability interconnect devices and PCB hardware, with facilities in the UK, USA, Germany, and Singapore.

With over 70 years of experience, Harwin offers a portfolio of more than 20,000 trusted products, supporting customers across aerospace, defense, automotive, medical, and other demanding industries.

Our global reach is strengthened by a network of distributors and regional offices in Europe, the USA, and Asia, ensuring we can meet customer needs locally while staying aligned with the latest technologies worldwide.

Name: Det-Tronics (Detector Electronics, LLC)
Description:
Det-Tronics is a global leader in fire and gas-safety systems. We provide flame and gas detection and hazard-mitigation systems for high-risk processes and industrial operations. The company designs, manufactures and commissions SIL 2 Capable flame- and gas-safety products that range from conventional panels to fault-tolerant, addressable systems that are globally certified.

Det-Tronics has provided engineered solutions with superior performance and reliability for over 50 years to major global customers in the oil, gas and petrochemical, automotive, aerospace, munitions, and chemical industries.
  
•  Our fire and gas safety systems support addressable-loop and point-to-point architectures -- all solutions are highly fault tolerant, configurable detection and releasing systems.

•  Our optical flame detectors incorporate the latest technologies in UV, IR, UV/IR, Dual IR, and Multispectrum IR to maximize detection while minimizing false alarms.
 
•  Our gas detectors accurately detect the presence of combustible and toxic gases using three major types of combustible and toxic gas detection technologies: fixed point, line-of-sight and acoustic. The full line includes nanotechnology metal oxide semiconductor (NTMOS), catalytic, electrochemical, and IR absorption technologies.  

Det-Tronics submits products to recognized third-party testing agencies around the world for verification of performance and quality.  Worldwide, we are also the recipient of hundreds of local and national approvals, certifying that our product has withstood each agency's most rigorous performance and area-classification tests.

LEARN MORE:  www.det-tronics.com

Name: Tria
Description:
Tria gets your products to market faster, better and stronger with compute, system and HMI innovation.

Our mission is to help OEM customers build user interface solutions that meet the future demand of innovation and quality with reduced time to market utilizing our platform technologies and design & manufacturing capabilities.

Tria builds embedded compute, system and HMI solutions that meet the demand for innovation and quality, with reduced time to market, utilizing Tria’s platform technologies, design and manufacturing capabilities, and a world-class team of experts.

Name: Gemma Lighting - UK Exterior LED & Solar Lighting Manufacturer – OEM
Description:
Gemma Lighting LTD was formed to create an innovative concept for everyday lighting requirements. Drawing on a vast experience of LED technology, our team at Gemma Lighting LTD continues to design, develop and manufacture a new generation of Environmentally friendly LED Lighting Solutions that can be utilised both indoors and outdoors.

Our range of LED Cold Store Lighting, LED Low Bay Lighting, LED High Bay Lighting and lighting solutions incorporate the most powerful, efficient Lighting Emitting Diodes (LEDs) available, which efficiently utilises the supplied power and typically reduces energy consumption by up to 75%. With a life span of over 50,000 hours, LED technology can offer fantastic cost savings on maintenance, almost making traditional light bulb replacement a thing of the past. In February 2013 Gemma's LED lighting was awarded 'Innovation of the Year' and the company were named 'Overall Business of the Year' at the Portsmouth News Business Excellence Awards.

The reduction of global warming is a joint responsibility and together we can help create a better world in which to live. So do not put off until tomorrow what you can achieve today.

Name: CAME UK
Description:
CAME is a leading multinational company, providing integrated technology solutions for automating residential, public and urban environments that creates smart spaces to improve human wellbeing.

The Group produces operators for entry points, home & building automation and security alarms, video entry technology, heat management and security for both residential and industrial settings. Thanks to the design skills of CAME’s Project Department, it also provides solutions for urban planning, automatic pay-to-park systems, parking meters, and access control and security systems at public venues.

The company presents itself on the market as a global technology company capitalising on the knowledge and experience of the important Italian and international businesses it is made up of, selling its products under the CAME, CAME BPT, CAME Entrotec, CAME KMS, CAME Parkare, CAME Ozak and CAME Urbaco lines.

Owned by the Menuzzo family, CAME S.p.A. is extremely proud of its Italian heritage. With a capillary network of 26 branches and 480 distributors and business partners in 118 countries around the world, the company's head office is located in Dosson di Casier, in the province of Treviso, Italy. Its six plants are located in Treviso, Sesto al Reghena (Pordenone, Italy), Spilimbergo (Pordenone, Italy), Avignon (France), Barcelona (Spain) and London (England). The company employs over 1,400 people.

Name: BAUR GmbH
Description:
BAUR is the world market leader of testing and measurement technology. High grade products, onsite consultation and intensive training programs and comprehensive service from BAUR guarantee optimum status monitoring of electrical insulation materials and power supply systems. With this, the company makes significant contribution towards efficient and problem-free power supply around the globe.

BAUR is always one step ahead. Constant innovations in power generation and distribution demand quick adaptation of the measurement and testing technology. To meet these requirements, BAUR bets on maximum flexibility and continuous consolidation of its core competencies: Cable testing and fault location, diagnosis and evaluation of reliability of cable systems and dielectric insulation material tests. At BAUR, we have merged long years of experience and passion for technology with the ambition for continuous advanced technological development.

BAUR customers include power station companies, network operators, public utility companies as well as industrial and service companies around the world. Intensive contact with customers and consistent implementation of their expectations for technical solutions are given the highest priority at BAUR.

New knowledge that helps to ensure the flow: www.baur.eu/newsletter-registration

Name: Smeg UK Ltd.
Description:
Technology with Style.

Smeg UK, established in 1989, has been supplying premium domestic appliances across the UK for more than 20 years.

Based in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, the company supplies an extensive range of over 750 products across all corners of the UK via its growing infrastructure network, of major retailers and distributors throughout England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland & the Republic of Ireland. 

The product range includes a vast choice of Italian inspired cooking appliances - ovens, hobs, range cookers and extractor hoods – as well as an ever expanding range of refrigerators, and washing machines. A wide selection of appliances can be viewed at Smeg’s Abingdon showroom.

Smeg also offers excellent logistics support with a large vehicle fleet and full home delivery service, supported by an 130,000 ft2 warehouse facility.

Smeg Service, the company’s award winning after sales and service division, is also on hand to provide full technical support through it’s network of trained engineers and local and national service centres.

Name: Acal BFi
Description:
We are a leader in advanced solutions for tomorrow’s technologies with a mission to empower innovators of electronic applications to turn ideas and designs into exceptional products.

Established for over 50 years, we partner with leading and innovative manufacturers to offer a comprehensive range of specialised products and solutions, covering a broad spectrum of the latest technologies. Our portfolio spans interconnect, sensors, communications, photonics, imaging, magnetic components, power supplies, and embedded computing.

In addition to top technologies, we complement these with invaluable engineering expertise as well as in-house capabilities in design, manufacturing, and supply chain proficiency to expedite, expand, and enhance the longevity of your creations.

We operate across 12 countries throughout Europe, each with its own dedicated salesforce and technical support teams.

For more information visit www.acalbfi.com or email sales-uk@acalbfi.co.uk

Name: Ovia Lighting
Description:
Already synonymous with superior performance and innovation following eight years of success as a leading name in the lighting industry, Ovia lighting solutions have been further developed to meet the growing opportunities that the transformed lighting industry offers.

Our comprehensive collection of lighting products provides solutions for a whole spectrum of projects in a broad variety of sectors, including: domestic, commercial, industrial, utility, amenity, emergency lighting and floodlighting as well as the further inclusion of a full range of lighting control solutions which are optimised for saving energy.

Being a part of Scolmore Group, we guarantee our partners high-quality, value-for-money products which are backed up by excellent local stocks, delivery service and the ability to offer detailed product support via trained staff.

Name: Kosnic Lighting
Description:
We help our customers think differently about their lighting, showing them how the right choices can combat increasing energy prices, reduce energy consumption and lower carbon emissions.
 
Lighting typically accounts for 25% to 40% of a building's energy use. Kosnic’s LED lighting uses between 50% and 90% less energy than traditional lamp types such as halogen, fluorescent or filament.
 
Since we first opened our doors in 2004, Kosnic Lighting has rapidly become a leading designer, manufacturer and established expert in emergency lighting, luminaires, LED lamps and bespoke lighting solutions.
 
Serving residential, commercial and industrial clients throughout the UK, Kosnic delivers quality, cost-effective and environmentally responsible LED lighting solutions.
 
Here’s how we do it: Working closely with our wholesale and distribution partners, we help you build a compelling business case so your customers can “see the light” when it comes to choosing a lighting solution for their business or home.
 
This could include:
1. Client liaison and site surveys – to build an accurate picture of the project, provide accurate replacement models and calculate cost savings
2. Cost of ownership calculations – to highlight the key comparisons between existing lamps and the proposed Kosnic LED replacement
3. Lighting design schemes
4. Technical support
5. Sales tools and product selection advice
 
We also offer an industry-beating 2-year on-site warranty on selected luminaire products, so you know you can confidently recommend and install them.

We understand that a key element of our success are our wonderful employees. As much as we believe in the importance of constantly evolving as a company, we also know how important it is for our people to evolve too.

This is why a core part of our ethos is the belief that when you give your employees the chance to learn and develop, you help them become the best they can be.

We’d love to help your business be the best it can be too.

Name: Power-Sonic
Description:
Power is an essential part of our everyday life. We all rely on power to keeps us safe, connected and on the move. The demand for power is increasing globally and that is one of the reasons why Power-Sonic is committed to providing quality, efficient and cost effective power solutions.

Power-Sonic has been a leading force within the battery storage industry for over 55 years, providing an innovative range of battery and power storage solutions.

Our range of batteries are designed and manufactured using the latest technology and state-of-the-art equipment to ensure that they met the unique demands of each application. Our range includes sealed lead acid (SLA) and lithium iron phosphate technologies (LiFePO4), chargers and related accessories.

Our battery products can be found in industries and applications in over 70 countries worldwide. Power-Sonic utilizes a worldwide distribution network with distribution hubs in Reno, NV (USA), London (UK) and Paris (France).

As well as supplying an innovative range of battery products we also provide complete power storage solutions to help solve some of the power challenges our customers have to face.

Our knowledge, experience and commitment enables us to find the best solutions available. Our strength lies in our customer focused approach to find the solution together. By working together we can find the right solution and help exceed customer expectations.

Our commitment to provide quality, efficient and cost effective power solutions, with a customer focused approach to service, sets us apart from the competition.

Our mission – To deliver battery solutions globally, through the supply of the highest quality technologies, at the fairest price allied with outstanding service.

For more information please visit our website

Name: Magnetek
Description: Founded in 1984 and headquartered in Menomonee Falls, in the Greater Milwaukee area, Magnetek specializes in the development, manufacture and marketing of digital power and motion control systems for material handling, people-moving, and mining applications. Our power control systems serve the needs of selected niches of traditional and emerging commercial markets that are becoming increasingly dependent on “smart” power.

Name: GEW (EC) Limited
Description:
GEW (EC) Limited is the world leading manufacturer of UV arc & UV LED curing equipment for printing, coating and converting applications. GEW systems are renowned for their rugged construction, effective design and energy-efficient operation.

GEW is a family-owned, British company manufacturing UV curing systems for printing, labelling, metal decorating and industrial applications. The company has a world-leading position in UV & LED UV curing technology, with thousands of installations across the globe.

The focus on long-term technical support and customer care ensures a GEW UV system runs efficiently throughout the lifetime of the machine to which it is fitted.

GEW is headquartered in England, with subsidiaries in Germany and the USA, and is supported by a worldwide distribution and service network. Furthermore, GEW’s RHINO powered UV systems are supplied, as standard, with the Embedded Service package which allows ‘Remote Monitoring’ to keep a watchful eye on each system’s running conditions over the internet. This allows the GEW Service Support Team to detect and correct out-of-tolerance parameters before they can develop into a fault. This type of remote preventive maintenance improves customer efficiency, whilst ensuring that customers can avoid unplanned machine stoppages and continue to operate the entire UV system at peak performance.

To find out more about the GEW product range, visit www.gewuv.com 

NB: Please do not apply for any job/role at GEW through LinkedIn. If you wish to apply for a role at GEW, please do so via the GEW website Jobs page. Applications submitted through LinkedIn may not reach the correct recipient.

Name: Hammond Manufacturing
Description:
Hammond Manufacturing first began in a backyard workshop crafting metal parts. In the late 1910’s this humble family business began building tube-driven radios and amplifiers. In the years that followed, Hammond grew to become a recognized name in numerous industries including industrial, telecommunications and electronics. Today Hammond is today a leading designer, manufacturer and marketer of equipment racks and cabinets, industrial and electronic enclosures and power distribution devices.

The Hammond brand of products are widely used in many different applications and have been recognized as a brand that designs and manufactures their products to be durable and long-lasting. 

Hammond offers a diverse product line that includes electrical and electronic enclosures, power outlet strips, electronic transformers as well as equipment rack and cabinet solutions for audio-visual, pro-audio and data/comm applications.

Hammond is a publicly held company (TSX: HMM.A) headquartered in Guelph, Ontario, Canada with offices located in four countries, including major facilities in Canada, USA, and Europe. Hammond products are sold and supported through a worldwide network of authorized Hammond partners.

Name: Luna - OptaSense
Description:
OptaSense, part of Luna Innovations, is the trusted partner for leading edge fiber optic Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) solutions that reduce the cost of asset ownership by optimizing operational efficiency, performance and safety. 

Our DAS solutions provide real-time, actionable data, dedicated expertise and global experience to multiple industries, including oil and gas, pipeline, security, transport and utilities.

Operating in over 50 countries with more than 25,000km of assets under contract, we are now monitoring and protecting some of the world’s most valuable assets.

Name: AndersDX
Description:
Anders is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge display and embedded systems to elevate devices to new heights.  

We empower customers to overcome real-world challenges and drive a more sustainable future by offering long life components and supporting many years of reliability in the field. 

• Delivering precision into every visual detail
• Safeguarding device integrity 
• Unleashing the full potential of your devices 
 
Our global operations are headquartered in the UK with offices spanning Europe and Asia. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and logistics centres ensure your products reach you on time, every time. 

Our innovative designs span: Health and Wellness, Transportation and E-Mobility, Industrial Control, Home and Building, Marine and Agritech. 

At our core, we value people and service above all. Our team of highly skilled engineers have optical, firmware, hardware, software and mechanical expertise to design and implement custom solutions.  

Bring your visionary concepts to reality and experience the difference with Anders.  

Get in touch to get started on your next innovative #Display and #Embedded design: info@andersdx.com

Follow us on:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/AndersElec
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/AndersElectronics

Name: GS Yuasa Battery Europe Ltd
Description:
For over 40 years, GS Yuasa Battery Europe Ltd have been the UK’s leading battery supplier. From sales and distribution centres in Swindon, Milan, Lyon, Madrid and Dusseldorf, and state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Ebbw Vale, UK, we supply an extensive range of high-quality energy storage, network stabilisation solutions and accessories. 

Our GS and Yuasa product ranges include some of the most well-recognised, trusted and high quality battery products for use in a diverse range of automotive, motorcycle, industrial and standby power applications.

Supported by experienced Quality Assurance, Technical Support, Marketing and Customer Service teams, our industry leading service and distribution network continues to set new standards in customer care, choice and year-round availability.

GS Yuasa Battery Europe Ltd is a subsidiary of the word-leading GS Yuasa Corporation which consists of 65 subsidiaries and 33 affiliates in countries throughout the world. 

For over 100 years, the GS Yuasa Group has continually contributed to economic development and the improvement of living standards through the development and manufacture of batteries, power supply systems and lighting equipment. 

Responding to today’s increasingly sophisticated needs, our extensive range of next generation energy system lithium-ion batteries encompasses not only vehicle use but also products in a wide range of fields, from deep sea to aerospace, to meet the ever more sophisticated needs of the times.

Name: Gtech
Description:
Since 2001, Nick Grey and his team of experts have been pushing the boundaries of innovation in vacuum cleaners, carpet sweepers and cordless garden tools, making Gtech the successful company it is today.

Our HQ in Worcester is home to our experts in Design, Engineering, Purchasing, Finance and Customer Support, IT and Marketing. 

Globally, we have sold over 20 million sweepers through our international partners making us experts in our field.

As ever, we have very ambitious plans for the future.

Name: Cadac Consoles
Description:
The Cadac name has been synonymous with professional audio for more than 50 years. From the earliest analogue studio mixing desks to today's digital live sound systems, Cadac has built a reputation for exceptional audio quality, engineering integrity, and console design that puts the engineer first.

Founded in 1968, Cadac takes its name from the first letter of each of the founders' Christian names: Clive Green, Adrian Kerridge, David Bott and Charles Billet. The first Cadac console was installed at the legendary Morgan Studios in London and saw the beginning of a long association with world-class recording environments. Over the following decades, Cadac consoles became renowned for their pristine signal path and sonic performance, helping shape the sound of countless iconic recordings and establishing Cadac as one of the most respected names in professional audio.

In 1984, Cadac entered the world of theatre sound, supplying a bespoke console for the West End production of Little Shop of Horrors at the request of sound designer Martin Levan. His requirement was straightforward but demanding: studio-quality audio for live theatre. That console set a new benchmark for theatrical sound reinforcement. What followed was decades of Cadac consoles at the heart of major productions across the West End and Broadway.

Today, Cadac combines that legacy with modern digital technology in the CM Series, a professional live sound mixing ecosystem designed for the demands of contemporary audio production. The CM-J50 delivers powerful FPGA/DSP processing, sub-0.4ms latency, and an intuitive touchscreen-based interface built for speed and reliability at front of house and monitors.

Every product in the Cadac CM Series is designed and manufactured in the United Kingdom. That commitment to British engineering ensures strict control over build quality, performance standards, and long-term reliability and reflects the same values that have defined Cadac for more than five decades.

That’s why we’ve taken upon ourselves to guide our customers towards the future of lift safety, to take on the challenges posed by this changing technological landscape – something we like to call the SafeLine journey. A journey you are all invited to take with us.

Let’s get going.

Name: T&R Test Equipment Ltd
Description:

Name: EC Electronics Ltd
Description:
From local manufacturer to global partner, EC Electronics has been a trusted EMS provider for over 40 years, helping businesses bring products to market with reliability, performance and scalability at every stage.

Name: Crompton Lamps
Description:
Crompton Lamps is one of the oldest lamp businesses in the world, founded in 1878 by the late Colonel Crompton, an entrepreneur with an interest in electricity. He designed and installed some of the earliest recorded electric lighting installations at buildings such as Windsor Castle and Holyrood Palace.

In 1927 Colonel Crompton formed a partnership with Frank Parkinson and together they founded Crompton Parkinson which developed into a substantial manufacturing business producing a whole range of industrial electrical products. This business flourished until 1968 when it was acquired by Hawker Siddeley aerospace group where it remained until 1991 when it was acquired by the industrial conglomerate BTR. Crompton Lamps was part of Crompton Lighting; in 1999 Crompton Lighting Ltd was acquired by Cooper Industries and operated under the name of Cooper Lighting and Security Ltd.

Following a review of its strategy, Cooper Industries decided to withdraw from the lamps business and as a consequence Crompton Lamps Ltd. was acquired by its management in January 2006 and relocated to its present site in Bradford.

Today we have a strong business with core values and specific aims:

• Investment in people
• To partner with our customers to develop open, long term relationships
• To have an unpretentious, straightforward and honest approach to business
• To operate in an environmentally friendly way
• To have high ethical standards
• To aim to have available at all times a broad product offering with adequate stocks to enable us to support the needs of our customers
• To encourage and support the use of low energy consumption light sources which assist greatly in the overall reduction of global carbon emissions

We believe that our people are the heart of Crompton Lamps and that we have talent, infrastructure and the commitment to serve our customers to the highest standards.

Name: GTK UK Ltd
Description:
GTK is a subsidiary of Volex plc, a $1,000M AIM listed business.

Name: Uson - Air Leak & Flow Measurement Solutions
Description: Uson is the premiere manufacturer of leak measurement equipment and solutions with a global network of experienced suppliers. Uson's team of leak testing experts have more experience in these specialized fields than any other company in the world.  Headquartered in Houston, Texas we are able to provide leak test solutions globally.
Location: Bury St Edmunds, England, United Kingdom

Name: Acrospire
Description:
A British manufacturer with a difference. Unlike many in our industry, we’re not owned by some big international multi-conglomerate. Acrospire is still 100% independent, and proudly owned (and led) by our founders, Tim and Hatty, who are as hands-on as ever.


Why Acrospire?
We support local: Our supply chain is all about community, operating within a 60-mile radius of our factory and (Basingstoke) HQ. By working with us, you’re supporting local businesses and contributing to the UK economy 

Made in Britain: When you choose Acrospire, you’re choosing British quality and craftsmanship. Not only that, but you’re also helping to reduce your carbon footprint and support the local economy

Obsessed with solutions: We didn’t just want to sell lighting. We wanted to change the game. Born out of a belief that the lighting industry deserved better, we focus on solving problems – not just ‘pushing’ products

Name: Elmdene International Ltd
Description:
Elmdene International Limited is a manufacturer of high quality, innovative electronic products for the security, access control, CCTV and fire industries. We are specialists in the core devices that systems depend on to provide reliable solutions, including power supplies; sounders, sirens and beacons; magnetic contacts; junction boxes and other ancillary devices. Our products provide the reliability, stability and flexibility that installers and end-users alike demand.

The company, a subsidiary of Potter Electric Signal, was established over forty years ago and is based in Portsmouth, along the south coast. We have enjoyed steadfast growth year on year largely due to the innovative design and highly reliable products we produce. 

We continually invest in research and development to ensure we deliver a high level of product and pride ourselves on being able to rapidly react to market demands. Our product range continues to grow with the introduction of new products to meet customer requirements and in response to the demands of new standards as they arrive in the market place.

Elmdene’s products offer true value for money – high quality, innovative products at competitive prices. We also have virtually zero product returns and offer 5 year warranties on our magnetic contacts, junction boxes, panic buttons and door loops and 3 year warranties on PSUs and sounders.

Name: Eterna Lighting
Description:
Eterna Lighting are market leaders in the supply of utility lighting across the UK and Ireland. With 80+years of lighting industry experience we provide reliable, cost-effective lighting products with industry leading levels of service and stock availability.

Our mission is to satisfy the everyday needs of electrical wholesalers, lighting professionals and electrical contractors.

Operating from our purpose built distribution centre in central England, we are well placed to serve customers nationwide. Our financial stability allows us to accommodate significant stocks in our modern 32,000 square foot high bay warehouse and with efficient order fulfilment systems we are geared to provide excellent service levels. We enjoy high levels of stock availability and our accurate and speedy delivery service is second to none.

We also offer for more complex projects, the ability to produce Lighting Design schemes to meet specific commercial needs, using Relux design software. 

We continuously monitor our products and manufacturing processes to ensure that the highest standards are maintained for the Eterna Brand. Our factories carry out pre-shipment quality control checks throughout production and all finished goods received into our Wellingborough distribution centre are subject to a rigorous quality control process by our team of Quality Inspectors using AQL inspection levels.

The Lighting Industry Association (LIA) is the leading authority on the lighting industry and related technologies in the UK. Indeed it plays a major part in the development of the British and European legislation.  Our membership of the LIA allows us to stay fully informed with industry norms and standards.

At Eterna, we strive for constant improvement and all of our strategic management and operational procedures are designed to drive quality through everything we do. Our management systems are audited annually to the ISO 9001 Quality Management standard.

Name: Pitts Wilson Limited
Description:
Mechanical & Electrical Design and Installation company specialising in Commercial, Retail, Industrial and Leisure Projects. Recently awarded ISO9001 and BAFE. We are able to offer a range of services including High Voltage works, Fire Alarm design, installation and maintenance. General mechanical & electrical contracting including a full design facility. Maintenance of existing installations throughout the UK.

We are delighted to announce that Pitts Wilson has successfully completed for Westfield Shopping Towns the Mechanical and Electrical Installation to the Landlords areas for the £270million Bradford Broadway shopping development.

Name: Datalink Electronics Ltd
Description:
Established in March 1983 Datalink Electronics Ltd is a renowned ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified UK contract electronics manufacturing company. We provide a wide variety of integrated design and production services that are tailored to the various needs of our customers.

Our services encompass conceptual design, PCBA layout, fast turnaround NPI, production and testing of PCBAs, and final product assembly, with a focus on low to medium volume, high mix product profiles for a variety of sectors. Name: oemsecrets.com

As part of Chase Corporation's Electronics portfolio, HumiSeal combines decades of materials expertise with a broad range of complementary technologies. Name: TheUPSTeam Ltd
Description:
TheUPSTeam Ltd are a young and dynamic business, specialising in Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) & the services surrounding these products. With over 60 years of experience among its board members, the passionate team are also extremely experienced in the market and experts in supply chain management, design, implementation & maintenance/servicing.

Purchasing a new UPS system has never been so easy, thanks to the supportive communication TheUPSTeam Ltd offers its clients. UPS servicing is handled by our group’s engineering team, with decades of hands-on experience, working on all major manufacturers' products. Having in-house, manufacturer trained & qualified engineers gives TheUPSTeam Ltd the ability to control engineer availability at all times.

Putting your needs first. Whether it means we win the business or not, we are devoted to putting our clients’ needs first. Our aim is to surpass expectations, every time.

Contact our team today: sales@theupsteam.co.uk

Name: Bernlite LED
Description:
Bernlite LED is the largest distributor of quality branded lighting control gear and associated components to electrical wholesalers and Original Equipment Manufacturers.

With over 40 years of experience in the distribution of lighting control gear, and a combined staff experience of over 100 years in the lighting sector, Bernlite LED is acknowledged as the market leader in the supply of lighting control gear products such as:

Lighting controls

Trust Bernlite LED to deliver

Name: Deben UK Limited
Description:
Deben UK Ltd. are a world leading design and manufacturer of accessory products for Scanning Electron Microscopes and X-Ray CT systems. We provide technical solutions for SEM and μXCT researchers looking to perform a variety of in-situ tensile and compression testing, using a range of standard products specifically designed and manufactured to suit these needs, supplied both directly and indirectly through agent and OEM distribution. The tensile and compression testing stages also come with a variety of heating and cooling options to provide in-situ observations under real world conditions allowing users the ability to see and understand dynamic changes to their specimens.
Our products are designed with universal applicability enabling their use on a wide range of leading original equipment manufacturers systems, supporting applications with SEM, TEM, optical, AFM and XRD, X-Ray, and Synchrotron enabling customers maximise the capabilities of their original investment.
Standard products with force ranges from as little as a few Newtons, up to 20kN with the addition of 100nM torsion, and temperature capabilities from -100oC to +1400oC are available, and, in addition, our in-house design and manufacturing teams are able to provide customised solutions to suit new and novel testing applications.
Further, Deben UK also provide a range of SEM chamber accessories, such as heating and cooling stages, STEM, backscatter, and cathode luminescence detectors, and chamberscopes to name but a few.
The Deben UK team provide customer service and support from their offices near Bury St. Edmunds, Suffolk, and through their agent network around the world. Check out the website at www.deben.co.uk for more information and why not get in touch with us to discuss your particular testing needs.
Location: Bury St Edmunds, England, United Kingdom

Name: KBC Networks
Description:
Welcome to our KBC Networks company page. We provide industrial transmission for CCTV & surveillance, industrial control systems, intelligent transport networks and site management systems. We provide the interfaces for cameras, sensors, and control equipment that drive signals securely over wireless links, LANs, private and public WANs, mobile, 3G/4G/LTE, copper and fiber optic networks.

No matter how good your endpoint technology is, the way you get your signals from A to B will ultimately decide how well your system works.  

Here are just some of the things our products allow your systems to do:

•  Deliver secure video, voice & data over public networks
•  Provide fast & secure communications when digging is out of the question
•  Stream video securely to and from patrol vehicles
•  Provide  communications in hostile and non-conditioned environments
•  Provide network redundancy in safety critical applications
•  Upgrade to IP with minimal cost, delays & disruption
•  Cut out the cost of leased lines
•  Operate with minimal footprint & power requirements 
•  Operate fully over a WAN

We work with other manufacturers to ensure that our products are compatible with theirs, we work with installers to make our products more straightforward to install, easier to troubleshoot, and we work with a network of trusted partners.

Name: iNetic Ltd
Description:
iNetic is a leading electric motor manufacturer with a rich history of innovation and collaboration. From our beginnings in 1997 as S&S Winding, specializing in precision stator manufacturing, to our transformation through mergers with JBS Racing in 2008 and Moto Optima in 2022, we have continuously expanded our expertise to deliver cutting-edge solutions.  

At iNetic, we specialize in build-to-print manufacturing, offering the capability to take your designs and transform them into fully manufactured, tested, and market-ready products. Our end-to-end services ensure your concepts are realized with precision, from prototype development to series production.  

Our product range spans multiple sectors, including automotive, aerospace, marine, and industrial applications. Whether you're seeking custom solutions or leveraging our innovative motor designs, like the iEV, iMR, and EDU product ranges, our platform-based approach ensures flexibility, adaptability, and scalability.  

With a global supply chain, state-of-the-art production facilities, and extensive testing and validation infrastructure, we deliver high-performance solutions that meet the most rigorous industry standards, including AS9100. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner, empowering customers to push the boundaries of innovation while meeting their unique requirements.  

Let’s engineer the future together. Whether you need build-to-print solutions, complete prototyping, or scalable production, iNetic is here to bring your ideas to life.

Description:
All over the world, as companies continue to look for ways to reduce their carbon footprint, eliminate waste, use sustainable resources and exploit new technologies, Nualight continues to break new ground and lead in developing high quality, performance and sustainable LED lighting solutions.

Name: TRT Lighting Limited
Description:
TRT Lighting Ltd (Thorlux Road and Tunnel Lighting) is one of ten companies within the FW Thorpe Group, and evolved from parent company Thorlux Lighting. Building on more than 85 years of experience, TRT designs, manufactures and supplies sustainable and environmentally friendly performance lighting products for the road/street, tunnel and exterior lighting markets.

LED lighting solutions bring another dimension to how roads, streets, tunnels and general exterior spaces are illuminated. TRT's ability to understand and adapt to the needs of its customers ensures that developed products are technically and mechanically sound and provide energy efficient, long-lasting lighting solutions with excellent returns on investment.  

The company is also committed to reducing obtrusive light and light trespass in order to protect the night sky from light pollution. This preservation is critical not only for the well-being of people and wildlife, but also for scientific and astronomical purposes. A range of TRT products can be used in dark-sky applications, thanks to their International Dark-Sky Association approval.

TRT Lighting are proud to manufacture its products in the UK.  All luminaires being rigorously tested to all relevant global and regional standards using in-house testing facilities.

We are also committed to minimising the environmental impact of both our manufacturing processes and our products. However, even with the most responsible approach, some carbon dioxide (CO2) will be released into the atmosphere as an indirect result of factory and selling activities and customers’ use of luminaires. As part of the FW Thorpe Group, we are involved in an ambitious Carbon Offsetting Scheme to help compensate for the emissions produced by the Group companies. The Group chose to plant trees on 215 acres of land in Devauden, Monmouthshire. Since 2009 we have planted 179,412 trees.

To satisfy all of our customer’s needs, we opened a new extrusion line in July 2017 in our French factory and created a production facility in Poland. Eurostat will duplicate its manufacturing expertise to cover the European market with renewed dedication. 

As the voting member for France in the IEC committee, we offer an ESD expertise that we fulfill by engineering new solutions to satisfy the latest technical evolutions of the industry. We have also invested in our in house ESD characterization laboratory for a better service to our customer. 

To accompany our products, we provide audits and structured training programs following a very complete structure to ensure that each and every one of our clients benefits from top of the line expertise to keeping their workspaces ESD safe.

With a direct presence in Europe, and a global presence in Asia and the US thanks to Dou Yee group, we are able to cover all global requirements with a local focus. At Eurostat, customer satisfaction is at the heart of our day to day activities. We are committed to providing you with the highest quality level of products and services. We are involved in safety and environmental issues; we manage industrial risks and physical hazards in order to ensure health and safety for all. Our products are made from raw materials that do not contain any Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) according to the ECHA and both REACH and RoHS regulations are met.

Description:
CQR is a trusted UK manufacturer of professional low-voltage cable and hardware solutions for intruder alarm, access control, emergency lighting and data systems. Supporting installers, distributors and system integrators across the UK and international markets, we deliver dependable products engineered for professional installations.

Since 1978, we have built our reputation on delivering dependable, high-quality low-voltage security cable, contacts and ancillary products. Decades of manufacturing expertise and a commitment to quality have established CQR as a trusted partner for professional installers.

Today, our portfolio spans four key product categories:
Cable | Intruder | Access Control | Emergency Lighting

From security and data cable to intrusion detection devices, sounders, contacts, access control hardware, locking solutions and emergency lighting, CQR provides the essential products that form the backbone of every system.

One trusted brand. More solutions. Built for professionals.
CQR – From Cable & Contacts to what every system depends on.

Name: TechPoint
Description:
TechPoint is a UK- based team of over 200 designers, engineers and problem solvers, powered by their shared passion for technology, innovation, and excellence. The team has over 40 years' experience delivering customer- centric, world- class electronics design, manufacturing and supply chain solutions.

We design, manufacture and distribute market- leading electronics for our global customers across demanding sectors like aerospace, healthcare and security - from prototypes to large scale operations.

Name: ISOTECH - Isothermal Technology Ltd
Description:
Temperature Calibration Equipment & Services

Isotech is a world leader in temperature calibration with over 45 years' experience in the design, manufacture and use of temperature calibration standards.

Temperature metrology equipment includes, Thermometry Bridges, Standard Platinum Resistance Thermometers and ITS-90 Primary Standards  used by the world's leading National Metrology Institutes as well as accredited temperature laboratories, research laboratories, pharmaceuticals, and Oil and Gas companies.

Industrial temperature calibration equipment includes portable dry block calibrators, liquid baths, furnaces, infrared calibrators and thermocouple referencing.

Isotech have complete calibration solutions; from metal block baths for calibrating thermocouples and RTDs, high accuracy liquid baths and furnaces to complete ITS-90 Primary Standards.


Isotech is renowned for innovation, with award winning products like the ISOTower ITS-90 Fixed Points, microK Thermometry Bridges, the milliK Precision Thermometer and ISOCAL-6; the multi function calibrator providing Dry Block, Liquid Bath, Surface Sensors, Blackbody and Fixed Point calibration in one piece of apparatus.

Global Network - local support. Isotech has over 90 authorized sales agents worldwide! No matter where you are we can offer local support.

Isotech has solutions for all calibration needs, from Primary Laboratories maintaining National Standards to the needs of field engineers calibrating industrial sensors on site. Isotech is truly “The Source for Calibration Professionals”.

At Isotech in addition to manufacturing equipment we also operate a full scale UKAS accredited laboratory (ISO/IEC 17025:2005) calibrating both our own equipment and a full range of temperature equipment for our clients, from industrial thermocouples to primary standards.

The world’s leading National Metrology Institutes choose Isotech – shouldn’t you?

Name: Jiva Materials Ltd
Description:
Jiva Materials is the creator of Soluboard, the world’s first fully recyclable printed circuit board (PCB) substrate (UL approved).

As the global demand for electronics continues to surge, the environmental impact of traditional PCBs has become a critical concern, with 18 billion square meters produced annually and electronic waste rapidly growing.

Our innovation, Soluboard, is a patented, sustainable, and cost-effective solution that addresses this challenge head-on. Designed to dissolve in hot water, it enables efficient recovery of valuable materials like copper and components, supporting a more sustainable circular economy. By working closely with industry experts, leaders in sustainable design, and collaborating with the university, Jiva is driving a future where eco-friendly engineering and responsible manufacturing are not just aspirations—but standards.

We are committed to transforming the PCB industry by helping manufacturers reduce their carbon footprint, meet stringent safety and environmental regulations, and improve resource efficiency. Together, we are redefining how electronics are produced, used, and responsibly recycled.

Name: Electronic Temperature Instruments Ltd
Description:
Electronic Temperature Instruments Ltd (ETI) is a British, award-winning manufacturer of digital thermometers for the food and industrial sectors.

Since 1983, we’ve been designing precision temperature and compliance solutions in Worthing, West Sussex.

Our innovative range of WiFi- and Bluetooth-enabled thermometers earned the Queen’s Award for Enterprise for Innovation (2018) — one of four Queen’s Awards received in six years.

Alongside manufacturing, we operate in-house UKAS-accredited calibration laboratories for both temperature and humidity, ensuring accuracy you can trust.

Explore our range or get in touch to find the right solution for your business.

Description:
Established over 30 years ago, Relay was incorporated in 1989 as Relay South-West, later changing its name to Relay Engineering in January 2007. In 2006 Relay was acquired by The Denholm Group and is now an integral part of Denholm Energy Services which has operations in the Caspian, Middle East, UK and USA.

Relay continues to provide mechanical, electrical and constructive engineering solutions to the marine, oil and gas sectors. We have branches in the UK and Middle East, and a subsidiary company, Relay Zholdas in the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Relay employs over 300 personnel, with skilled individuals in the mechanical and electrical trades. Our teams are flexible and multi-skilled allowing rapid deployment worldwide.

We are a preferred supplier to a number of major defence contractors and with a range of other distinctive and diverse customers.

We undertake regular training and development to ensure our workforce has the necessary competences or skills to work safely, to meet customer quality requirement to ensure they remain current with industry standards and working practices.

With offices and workshops located in Plymouth, Portsmouth, Falmouth and Portland we are ideally located to support the defence and marine sectors in the UK. Our registered branches in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia enable us to provide core services to the Middle East.

Our head office and main workshop is based in Plymouth where we have an extensive workshop and storage facilities. Our subsidiary company Denholm Engineering Limited workshop is based in Aberdeen servicing the Oil and Gas sector.  As a member of Denholm Energy Services we are well positioned to carry out complex turnkey projects.

Name: Martindale Electric Co. Ltd
Description:
With over 95 years of experience, Martindale Electric is one of the most trusted brands in electrical safety testing.

Our reputation for providing innovative and time-saving electrical measurement solutions for electricians and service professionals is backed up by a high standard of local service and support.

The company leads the way in safe isolation, providing simple and reliable solutions to ensure circuits have been de-energised and properly isolated prior to maintenance and modifications. Martindale electrical safety kits enable electricians and service personnel to stay safe by proving dead and locking off circuits during installation and maintenance, essential for compliance with Electricity at Work Regulations.

In addition to a market leading range of voltage testers, proving units, socket and continuity testers, Martindale Electric products include a comprehensive range of 18th edition installation testers, PATs and electrical and environmental test tools.

Name: Trumeter

Operating in the UK since 1937 and in the USA in 1938, we have sales in more than 30 countries through a worldwide network of Sales Executives, Distributor Partners and strategically located operations.

Name: Illumino Ignis
Description:
We specialise in the design, supply, and support of fire safety, PA/VA, emergency lighting, and disability products.

Supply: We design and manufacture innovative fire safety products to address on-site challenges and maintain an extensive stock of over 100 trusted brands, ready for next-day delivery.

Proud winners of the 'Distributor of the Year' award at the Fire & Security Awards 2024.

Name: EMC & COMPLIANCE INTERNATIONAL
Description:
It is with great pleasure, on behalf of the organising committee, that I welcome you all to EMC & CI 2026, taking place in the distinguished and historic city of Oxford.
  
This year, EMC & CI 2026 will bring together a very diverse community of engineers, industry professionals and researchers to explore the latest advances and challenges in electromagnetic compatibility and interference. It will blend in the same event and in the same location, both a practical training course and a technical and scientific conference. Over the three days, participants will have the opportunity to upskill in a research and development environment, engage in thought-provoking discussions, share pioneering research, and exchange insights on emerging technologies. The technical and scientific program features papers and presentations on current trends, and in-depth technical tutorials and workshops designed to foster dialogue and collaboration across disciplines.
 
More than simply combining training courses and conferences, EMC & CI 2026 aims to be a meeting of minds, a space for innovation, cooperation, and inspiration. It is also a chance to renew professional friendships, establish new connections, and enjoy the intellectual and cultural atmosphere that Oxford offers in abundance.
 
We look forward to welcoming you to Oxford and to sharing an enriching and memorable EMC & CI 2026 with you all.

Name: Rayfast

Name: ZoneSafe - Proximity Warning & Alert Systems
Description:
ZoneSafe is a proximity warning safety system developed by Avonwood Developments to help prevent dangerous interactions between vehicles and pedestrians on busy industrial worksites.

Using advanced RFID technology, ZoneSafe creates 360° detection zones around vehicles, machinery and high-risk areas. When vehicles and people come into close proximity, the system delivers real-time audible, visual and vibration alerts to improve situational awareness and reduce collision risk.

ZoneSafe systems are used across industries including waste & recycling, logistics, manufacturing and materials handling to help organisations protect their workforce and improve worksite safety.

Designed and manufactured in the UK by Avonwood Developments.
Part of the Made in Britain campaign.

Name: OKW Enclosures Limited
Description:
OKW Enclosures Limited is the UK subsidiary of OKW Gehäusesysteme GmbH of Germany. For over 40 years the OKW has specialised in the design and manufacture of standard enclosures for the OEM electronics industry. Today our products are used in a huge range of fields including medical, instrumentation and industrial control.

Our award winning plastic enclosures offer unique and innovative design features which allow for easier design-in of the electronics. For example PCBs, connectors, keypads and controls can all be accommodated without the need for major modifications. 

OKW manufacture a huge range of sizes and styles including:
- Wearable Enclosures
- Handheld Enclosures
- Desktop and Keypad Enclosures
- IP 54 to IP 66 Sealed Enclosures
- Wall Mount Enclosures
- DIN Rail Enclosures
- Tuning Knobs
- Accessories

Our management systems are approved to ISO 9001:2015.

Call 01489 583858 today to discuss your exact requirements with our product specialists.

Name: Memcon Limited
Description:
Memcon is a Global Supplier to the Membrane Switch and Flexible Technology Industry. 
With customers located in countries all over the world, Memcon has grown over the last ten years to be a multinational business with facilities in Hong Kong, Michigan USA, Shenzhen China, Letchworth England and Keele Germany. As a leading supplier in our specialist market place, we have diversified our product range from Electro-Mechanical technology used in our extensive range of Connectors and Metal Domes, to the latest in Opto technology to bring to the market one of the worlds thinnest LED’s in a 1206 Chip Package. By investing in the latest in leading edge techniques to manufacture our products and at the same time utilizing these techniques alongside the opportunities for lower cost manufacturing, we aim to give our customers a cost effective solution and benefit when incorporating Memcon products in their application.

We continually expand our product range, exploring new techniques and packaging methods. Our aim is to help our customers utilize cost effective assembly methods.

If you are seeking a new solution to realize your newly designed project, or you are looking to cost down your current design or process, contact our office and one of our Business Development Specialists will be happy to talk you through our available options. Our team have extensive experience, not only of our products and components but also manufacturing/process knowledge to help complement this.

We look forward to proving our service and commitment to you.

Name: TouchNetix
Description:
TouchNetix is a global leader in creating innovative user experiences based on touch technology. The aXiom family of user interface chips enable touchless user interfaces and 3D sensing capabilities to create new and innovative features for modern product development. 

TouchNetix manufactures chips and touch sensor modules to a world-wide customer base with offices in Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, USA, Korea, Taiwan and through several distribution partners.

TouchNetix’ aXiom chips are designed for the Automotive, Appliance, Medical, and other Industrial market’s touch user interfaces. The aXiom chips enable Touchless and 3D sensing above the surface as well as force sensing touch alongside traditional Touch capabilities, with no need for separate sensor technologies such as camera or infrared.

TouchNetix has decades of experience with capacitive touch technology and has a proven track record delivering to a global customer base.  

TouchNetix is QMS certified to ISO 9001 with an IATF-16949 certified supply chain.

Name: Telonic Instruments Ltd
Description:
Programmable Power Supply and Test and Measurement Instrument Specialist. 
Established in the U.K. in 1966 as the sales and service operation of Telonic Industries Incorporated, a U.S. company specialising in R.F. products, we became an independent company following a management buy-out in 1982, continuing to sell Telonic Industries products, as well as becoming the U.K. distributor for Kikusui Electronics Corporation of Japan in 1976. Description:

Name: AO Recycling
Description:
As the only retailer with its own recycling plant, AO opened the doors to AO Recycling in spring 2017, and in the last five years, we’ve safely processed five million appliances.

Very early aspirating smoke detection systems
Video smoke detectors
Linear heat detection
Open-area smoke detection
Firefighting telephone systems
Combustible gas detection systems
Carbon monoxide detection systems
Power supply units
Voice evacuation systems

Since the beginning, Eurofyre have retained sole UK distribution and technical support of their range of highly flexible ICAM aspiration smoke detection products.

Name: AceOn Group
Description:
AceOn Group, the battery power specialists, based in Shropshire, specialise in the design and assembly of custom built battery packs and the distribution of industrial and consumer batteries to the UK & worldwide market.

AceOn also have a battery energy storage division providing a UK based training, service and distribution centre to offer a complete solution for residential and commercial properties for lithium-ion battery energy storage systems including inverters and solar panels.

Description:

Key benefits of ReUSE

Completely unzippable printed circuit electronic assembly allowing Recyclable and Reusable substrates and components, feeding a circular economy

Reusable electronic components saves 2.3Bn Tonnes of CO2e per year based on just 10% of PCBs being changed to a ReUSE assembly, which is the equivalent carbon offset of 91 Million mature trees per year

ReUSE substrates typically consume up to 20x less CO2e to manufacture compared with traditional substrate methods, whilst also being highly economical to recycle

Drive for an opportunity to cease landfill E-waste through 100% recycling of substrates, conductive circuits, and electronic components, via ultra-low energy unzipping and second-life usage for constituent parts

Description:
The Limpet heating system consists of a range of patented, intelligent, microprocessor controlled, waterproof compact heating modules that can be fitted on a wide range of equipment to provide process heat or heat maintenance for industrial processes or frost protection.  
It is ideal for fitting to pumps, valves, meters, pipes, pipe flanges, tanks, IBCs, vessels and other equipment that is difficult or expensive to heat using traditional means, such as trace heating, hot air, induction electrical heaters or hot water systems.
The Company has a range of heating products:
- The patented AlphaLimpet is a modular, intelligent, sealed, process heating device which is mounted on an adaptor block that is secured to the item being heated. It can heat up to 80°C.  
- The BetaLimpet is a "slave" unit the same size as the AlphaLimpet which is normally driven from a control AlphaLimpet, either with a pre-set temperature or with external temperature control.
- The MicroLimpetTM is a smaller heating unit that can either work independently with a pre-set temperature control or act as a "slave" unit driven from a control AlphaLimpet. It can heat up to 250°C.  
- The OmegaLimpet is a pipe flange heater with a pre-set temperature control. Various size options are available for easy installation to a range of standard pipe flange sizes. It can heat up to 250°C.  
- The DeltaLimpet is a suitably-profiled adaptor block containing a suitably-rated electrical heater controlled by a variable thermostat. These can be a standard size or customised to fit onto a particular workpiece and can operate up to 300°C.
