Name: LED Illusions
Description:
LED Illusions was started in 2018 by Kevin Wagener, an Electronics Engineer and IT Consultant with over 25 years experience in the IT & Consumer Electronics industries.

The concept originally began in Autumn 2017 as a DIY project to make an affordable alternative to the extremely expensive “Pixel” Poi available. Whilst the expensive products are extremely good, they are aimed squarely at the professional market and priced accordingly.

The concept itself is very simple and relies on something called Persistence Of Vision (POV for short), which is basically the human eye’s inability to keep up with fast moving objects. Simplified, our eyes can’t keep up with a fast moving object so we see it for a fraction of a second after it has actually left the space we see it in. By flashing pixels, or LEDs at a sufficient speed, we can trick our eye into thinking it’s actually seeing a picture built up of several rows of the same LEDs!

There is absolutely nothing new about this concept, in fact John Logie Baird used the exact same principle to broadcast the first television picture in 1924 and to this day, it is still the principle behind the pictures you see on your TV screen.

Our aim is to create innovative, exciting products that produce exciting images and graphics, but at a price within reach of amateur, less experienced spinners. We recognise that there are many enthusiasts that don’t yet have the confidence to experiment with fire and are not committed to the point where they can justify spending hundreds, if not thousands of pounds on professional products.

Design is the creation of a plan or convention for the construction of an object or a system (as in architectural blueprints, engineering drawings, business processes, circuit diagrams and sewing patterns).[1] Design has different connotations in different fields (see design disciplines below). In some cases the direct construction of an object (as in pottery, engineering, management, cowboy coding and graphic design) is also considered to be design.
More formally design has been defined as follows.
(noun) a specification of an object, manifested by an agent, intended to accomplish goals, in a particular environment, using a set of primitive components, satisfying a set of requirements, subject to constraints;
(verb, transitive) to create a design, in an environment (where the designer operates)[2]
Another definition for design is a roadmap or a strategic approach for someone to achieve a unique expectation. It defines the specifications, plans, parameters, costs, activities, processes and how and what to do within legal, political, social, environmental, safety and economic constraints in achieving that objective.[3]
Here, a "specification" can be manifested as either a plan or a finished product, and "primitives" are the elements from which the design object is composed.

Name: Remote Power Quality Ltd
Description:
The Remote Power Quality Reporting & Analytics Platform is a unique, low cost offering, developed to address challenges commonly faced by facility operators. Our nationwide network of resellers/integrators can enable the transfer of data from existing fixed metering to our secure cloud server, providing permanent data recording and event capture. 

Our bureau of power quality consultants can then recall the data for the purpose of bespoke or scheduled reports, giving the facility operator valuable insight into critical metrics.

For as little as £350 per annum/per transformer, our detailed report features consumption, maximum demand, true transformer loading, harmonic loss factor analysis, capacity released by mitigation, power factor, reactive power consumption, effectiveness and dilapidation of PFC equipment, sizing of PFC, harmonic voltage and current analysis, impact of load changes, background distortion analysis (neighbours), voltage trending/management/event capture, detection of upstream voltage changes, frequency disturbances, current trending & event capture, unbalance and computation of transformer losses. 

The integrated one-page executive summary features energy, carbon and cost savings associated with PFC hardware, voltage management (transformer tap down), balancing of phase voltages and replacement of existing transformer assets, where applicable.

In addition to our unique reporting system, unlimited access to a client portal can be provided to observe basic power and energy consumption profiling (RPQ Profiling) and live data (RPQ Live). Bespoke email alerts can also be facilitated if predetermined set points are exceeded (RPQ Alarms).

With a soft launch of our offering in 2021, RPQ is gathering considerable momentum and is already being rolled out to some well know national consumers.

After 3 years of R&D, our team of power quality, HV and software engineers have great confidence in the product and we welcome all enquiries.

True World Leadership In Voltage Control and Voltage Optimisation

World status is all too easy to claim but Watford Control can offer solid proof. Established in 1947 with the aim of tackling the post-war mains supply problems of the period, which became even more acute with the introduction of sophisticated mains powered equipment. Ever since then Watford Control has specialised in AC Voltage Stabilisation and Power Conditioning, solving mains supply problems Worldwide.

All mains powered equipment requires a supply, which is maintained within certain limits; a low supply voltage causes malfunction, whilst a high supply voltage will cause serious damage. Microprocessor based systems and other sensitive equipment requires not only a stable voltage but also a supply free of transient spikes and electrical noise. In many developing economies, power demand is outstripping supply capacity giving rise to large voltage swings, surges and brownouts in the national supply. 

To meet the growing needs Watford Control engineers and management have constantly advanced the performance of our AC Voltage Stabilisers and Power Conditioners keeping abreast of the latest developments in control voltage technology. Through all these years the company has continued to lead the way with faster response, smoother surge-free operation and complete reliability. This is just some of the experience that went into creating DiGiCo's first product, the D5 Live digital mixing system, which brought with it a revolutionary approach to both the live sound console and the way it interfaces with both ends of the audio chain.

DiGiCo has always been ahead of its time, basing the D5 around a powerful DSP engine using proven Soundtracs hardware and software, but with features dedicated to live sound mixing, it created the world's first truly open-ended console system. 

Now, it has taken a quantum leap forward.

Description:
Peak Scientific is a leading innovator in the design, manufacture and support of high performance gas generators for analytical laboratories. Established in the UK in 1997 near Glasgow (Scotland), where its corporate Headquarters, and high-tech manufacturing and R&D facilities reside, Peak Scientific boasts a significant local presence on every continent – including major operations in North America, China and India.

With nearly two decades of experience in pioneering reliable gas generator technology, Peak Scientific develops market-leading nitrogen, hydrogen and zero air systems mainly for the field of LC-MS (Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry) and GC (Gas Chromatography).

Our forte is in providing our customers with high quality, dependable gas generation solutions tailored to meet their specific laboratory demands. With varying flow rates, purities and pressures of gas generators, available with or without internal air compressors, Peak is confident to offer the complete solution to your total gas requirements. Name: Roombanker
Description:
About Roombanker
Roombanker, established in 2017 and backed by over 20 years of wireless IoT expertise from our parent company —— Dusun IoT, designs and manufactures innovative wireless home security systems. Our "RBF chipset + RBF protocol stack + scenario-based solutions" powers a range of products, including intrusion alarms, video surveillance, fire alarms, and intelligent automation. 

Wireless Intruder Alarm System: The Home Security Hub integrates seamlessly with devices like door/window sensors, PIR motion detectors, smoke alarms, and cameras. Using advanced wireless technology, it transmits real-time data to cloud servers and mobile apps, triggering instant sound, light, and notification alerts for unauthorized intrusions, ensuring comprehensive protection for homes and small businesses.
RB Link Mobile App: Compatible with Android and iOS, RB Link offers an intuitive interface, supports 10+ languages (e.g., English, Romanian, Greece), and simplifies security management for global users, from daily control to multi-device monitoring.
RBF Protocol Stack: Our two-way wireless protocol leverages Sub-1G and TDMA for long-range (3.5km), low-power (<2μA standby), and secure (AES-CCM encryption) communication. With strong interference resistance (50 frequency channels) and a forwarding protocol (Q4 2025), it ensures reliable, scalable connectivity for industrial and residential scenarios, compatible with RTOS, OpenWRT, and MQTT.

Global Presence and Partners
Roombanker’s two-tier channel structure (national and regional agents) empowers partners through a scientific profit-sharing model, ensuring resources for market expansion and top-tier service. Our network spans Northern Europe, Southeastern Europe’s Mediterranean region, and Turkey, with ongoing investments in emerging markets like the GCC, North Africa, and Southeast Asia. Name: DW Windsor
Description: For over 45 years, DW Windsor has delivered high-quality lighting equipment to the global specification market. Founded in 1976, the British manufacturer is recognised as a leading producer of external lighting solutions. With a rich heritage of skills and expertise, DW Windsor is powered by people with a shared passion for light, committed to delivering outstanding service to its customers. As an outdoor lighting specialist, DW Windsor’s luminaires are engineered to offer exceptional quality and performance through continued innovation and precision manufacturing. Name: Lumineux Lighting
Description:
Lumineux is a family-owned and operated business with over 40 years of experience delivering high-quality lighting solutions backed by exceptional customer service.

As a UK-based manufacturer and distributor, we proudly design and supply our own brand of premium LED lighting products. Built on decades of industry expertise, we continually invest in innovation, service improvement, and added value for every customer who chooses Lumineux.

Since our founding in 1986, we have earned a strong reputation for providing an extensive range of commercial and industrial lighting solutions. Our products are supported by a dedicated team of highly trained lighting specialists and come with warranties of up to five years, ensuring reliability and long-term peace of mind.

Lumineux products are available exclusively through leading national electrical wholesaler groups and independent wholesalers, serving a growing network of satisfied customers across the UK. As industry standards and regulations continue to evolve, we remain committed to supporting electrical contractors and specifiers through our free lighting design service, helping to identify the most effective solutions, and where necessary, developing new products to meet specific project requirements.

All design and testing are carried out at our Lincolnshire facility, giving us complete control over product quality, performance, and compliance.

Name: Quantum Design
Description:
For more than 40 years Quantum Design (QD) has been providing technology solutions to researchers in the fields of physics, chemistry, biotechnology, materials science, and nanotechnology. Established in 1982 in San Diego, California, Quantum Design is the leading commercial source for automated materials characterization systems offering a variety of measurement capabilities. 

QD instruments are found in the world’s leading research institutions and have become the reference standard for a variety of magnetic and physical property measurements. Quantum Design instruments are cited in, and provide the data for, more scientific publications than any other instrument in the fields of magnetics and materials characterization. This means that each year, literally hundreds of scientific publications, advancing the science of materials, use data generated from QD instruments. 

An essential part of providing scientific solutions to researchers around the globe is to also offer state-of-the-art instruments from other leading manufacturers. These manufacturers are chosen by Quantum Design not only for their innovative products, but also because they believe in the same level of customer satisfaction and support that scientists have come to expect from QD products worldwide. 

With headquarters in the USA, and offices in Belgium, Brazil, China, Czech Republic, Germany, France, Hungary, India, Italy, Japan, Korea, Poland, Romania, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Taiwan, Turkey, and the United Kingdom, QD is strategically located in the world’s key centers for scientific research, providing local marketing, sales, and technical support.

Name: GENERAL HVAC Solutions UK Limited
Description:
Welcome to the Linkedin page of General HVAC Solutions UK Ltd. A world leader in design and technology. We design and manufacture a broad and innovative range of air-conditioning systems to provide the perfect solution for both residential and commercial environments.

General HVAC Solution has long been known for its comprehensive range of advanced and highly reliable units. Now, UK customers have both great products and superb service, delivered by our professional and friendly Sales and Customer Support teams.

Name: PR electronics
Description:
PR electronics is the trusted partner for the process and factory automation industry. We specialize in making industrial process control safer, more reliable and more efficient.
 
We design, develop and manufacture world-class signal conditioning devices for the process and factory automation industry. 

We set the standard for product reliability, user-friendliness and innovation. Our dedicated sales force connects with more than 10,000 customers worldwide to help them make their processes safer, more accurate and more efficient.
 
Our clear focus helps us stand out! 
 
 
Everyday, more than 200 employees work relentlessly at designing and producing signal conditioning (interface) devices for the process industry within temperature, I.S. interfaces, panel meters, signal isolators, signal conditioners and converters. We are one of the world’s leading manufacturers of signal conditioning products with an installed base of 5,000,000+ units. 

In fact, we focus solely on signal conditioning and pride ourselves on doing everything in-house at our headquarters in Rønde near Aarhus, Denmark.
The fact that we carry out the entire process from bare board to the final product in our own factory means that we are able to increase reliability, flexibility and speed for our more than 10,000 customers across the globe. Every product we ship has been thoroughly tested and calibrated at our integrated development and manufacturing campus.

Today, we provide businesses and homes in more than 70 countries with an extensive range of high-quality drinking and hot water solutions, designed to transform the way individuals, organisations and businesses provide water, for good.
 
The values at the core of our products are simple – quality craftsmanship, unparalleled design, unbeatable technology and a sustainability promise. Name: FFE Ltd

Name: Tamura Corporation
Description:
The company that would eventually become the Tamura Group came into being in 1924, one year before the start of radio broadcasting in Japan, as the Tamura Radio Store. Its main business was radio repair and the manufacture of original radios. In the process of pursuing superior sound, the firm came to handle the manufacture of the key component, the transformer.

Its reputation as the “Tamura of transformers” created a foundation on which to expand its businesses, including various electronic components related to transformers; flux and soldering materials that were born out of the pursuit of quality joining materials for the manufacture of transformers; soldering systems; and even broadcast audio equipment and communication systems, based on achievements in the manufacture of transformers for broadcasting and communication.

Currently, Tamura Corporation conducts business operations in three areas: electronic components, electronic chemical mounting, and information equipment, to develop and supply products that meet the needs of new markets, such as the environment and energy markets.

Tamura’s products have been supporting various industries and social infrastructure as “materials,” “components,” and “devices” that range from consumer products, such as automobiles and electronic equipment, to devices at manufacturing sites and natural-energy-related and aerospace fields. From raw materials to complete systems, Tamura’s technologies have contributed to safety and comfort as well as energy savings.

With the aim of continuously providing safe and secure high-quality products and services that satisfy customers from all over the world, the Tamura Group has been working on resolving social issues by promoting business activities while taking social and environmental impacts into account in all processes ranging from R&D, procurement, and production to sales.

Name: Vulcanic
Description:
Vulcanic has been designing and manufacturing electrical heating and cooling solutions since 1973. 
Employing 750 people across 11 manufacturing locations, Vulcanic currently services 30 000 customers in 100 different countries across the globe and is an ISO 9001 v 2008 accredited company.
Vulcanic offers a wide range of solutions for electrical industrial heating and cooling (of liquids, gas and solids) including temperature measurement, control and power supply.
Those solutions consist of a combination of:
- heating elements, screw immersion heaters, flow heaters, process heaters, heating cables, heating panels, heating hoses, heating cartridges, band heaters, electrical industrial radiators, fan heaters, finned strip heaters, air duct heaters ...
- thermostats, temperature sensors, temperature probes, pt100 sensors, thermocouples, indicators, measuring transducers, temperature controllers, power units, control panels ...
- temperature control unit for water or oil medium, hot, hot/cold and hot/cool, air conditioners for electrical cabinets , heat exchangers air/water, chillers ...

They do suit safe but also hazardous areas. They can then include ATEX immersion heaters, ATEX flow heaters, ATEX temperature sensors, ATEX thermostats, ATEX panels ...

With a strong focus on LED innovation, energy saving tech, we design lighting that delivers performance, reliability and ease of installation - trusted by electricians and wholesalers across the UK.

From build-to-print through to semi-custom and fully custom battery packs, our structured approach to battery projects gives customers clarity, control and a reliable route from concept to production.

Name: Batt Cables Worldwide
Description:
Batt Cables has been a trusted name in cable distribution since 1952. Today, as part of Elloumi Group, we combine more than 70 years of UK market expertise with the strength of a global industrial group.

We supply high-quality cable solutions for the construction, industrial, infrastructure, energy, utilities, data center, marine, rail, and OEM sectors across the UK and international markets.

As part of Elloumi Group, we benefit from expanded manufacturing capabilities, global expertise, and an international network that strengthens our ability to support customers today and into the future.

At BATT, we remain committed to being The Trusted Choice, delivering quality products, technical expertise, and reliable service every time.

Name: SPI Lasers
Description:
TRUMPF Laser UK Ltd (formally SPI Lasers) design and manufacture optical fiber-based lasers for a wide range of industries including automotive, medical, solar, printing and consumer electronics.

The company was established in 2000 and began selling its products commercially in 2003. Since then, SPI Lasers has grown from strength to strength. The company now has research, development and manufacturing facilities in the United Kingdom, along with additional sales and customer support in Asia and North America. Products are sold globally, with applications including welding, cutting, marking and engraving.

SPI Lasers’ aim is to become the world’s leading designer of optical fiber-based lasers. It continually invests in improving its technology and remains at the forefront of innovation in the sector. SPI Lasers was listed on the UK stock market in 2005 and acquired by TRUMPF in 2008. Visit the company’s website to learn more about their products, applications and benefits.

A leading innovator since the early days of active fiber development we are well respected by our customers for our materials and fabrication knowledge, as well as our ability to innovate at the glass level; bringing truly unique Fiber Lasers to market, that simultaneously address the needs of both applications, and product manufacturing.

Name: OceanLED
Description:
At OceanLED, we continuously strive to be recognised as the most innovative designer and manufacturer of underwater lighting solutions. 
Our vision is to become known globally as the most professional, innovation-led, sustainable lighting provider and be a beacon of quality British innovative design, product development and manufacturing. 

Our products are designed in-house and with the tenet of maximum output and effect for minimal energy use. From our first lights in 2014 through to our current generation, OceanLED was the first company to use LED for underwater lighting, recognising the benefits to the marine environment of moving away from HID Lighting. Since then, the industry has followed suit and is predominantly LED driven. All our lights are custom built in-house and are designed to operate to maximum efficiency, both in light output and power consumption. Our research allows us to develop a unique range of optics to produce controlled and efficient lighting, which help to reduce the environmental footprint by using no more energy than necessary and limiting heat output into the ocean. This resource-consciousness is at the heart of our company vision and is a core element of our aspiration to be the most sustainable lighting provider in the industry.

We are on a journey of continuous improvement, and we are always open to understanding more about our impact on our precious natural environment, especially the marine environment in which we operate. We have a clear intention to constantly develop sustainable and innovative technology and invest in R&D with our natural environment and the circular economy in mind.
 
We are a proud partner of the Water Revolution Foundation as part of a range of tangible collaborations, projects and efforts through which we can learn, develop and engage with the marine community and work towards the common goal of improving our long-term impact on our planet.

Name: Cressall Resistors Ltd
Description:
Cressall Resistors offers a wider range of technologies than any other power resistor manufacturer in the world and over 100 years’ experience in the design and manufacture of electrical resistors for use in power generation, high voltage and medium voltage power distribution, marine and offshore electrical systems, drives and controls for cranes, hoists and industrial machinery, rail traction and standby power systems.

We make neutral earthing and neutral grounding resistors for medium voltage electrical distribution networks; dynamic braking resistors for inverter drives; portable load banks for testing diesel generators, uninterruptible power supplies and batteries; dummy loads for the routine testing and operation of diesel power plant and high voltage filter resistors which form part of HVDC converter stations and Capacitor Damping Networks.
Cressall has developed a new lightweight and very compact liquid cooled resistors for the braking systems of hybrid and all-electric vehicles. 

Our range of edge-wound, grid, wire-wound, strip, expanded mesh and sheathed element resistor technologies enables us to offer appropriate and cost-effect designs for all these applications, using natural convection, fan cooling or water cooling either directly or indirectly by heat-exchanger.

Name: Synapsys Solutions Ltd
Description:
Synapsys Solutions innovative hardware and software solutions help improve building performance, reduce time pressure on facilities personnel and help building owners improve the sustainability and well-being of their buildings and occupants.

So how do we do that?

Now that almost all building technologies come with controls fitted, the challenge is to get them to work together. Our SIP+, SIP2 and legacy SIP products enable decentralised systems to communicate together effectively and to present the key information from them to a broad range of building users, utilising smart display technologies. Furthermore our products enable the transfer of data held in those systems to enterprise applications as well as our own SIPinsight billing and SIPinsight Energy and Building Information Software solutions for managing building performance, energy management and tenant billing.

Why Hurtwood?  

We believe that the management of building services, and hence the built environment, has seen little real innovation over the last 20 years. This has saddled end users with unnecessarily high running costs in terms of energy consumption and maintenance, and this results in poor quality environments. The equipment that delivers this underwhelming performance is expensive, frequently obsolete and poorly installed. 

We believe that it doesn't have to be this way. It can be done better and Hurtwood is committed to doing so.

We exist is to provide clients with expert & innovative advice and, where required, the equipment and tools to transform the management of their built environments, lowering energy and maintenance costs, and making their buildings more sustainable.

With this in mind Hurtwood uses a Strategic Whole Building Approach to address the opportunities to save energy and the challenges of Building Management Systems (BMS) obsolescence.  We assess the building itself and its issues before we assess the mechanical and electrical services. Finally, we assess the BMS, after which we can publish a strategy for its upgrade and outline the likely savings available. 

Hurtwood has developed an innovative range of retrofit BMS products and field equipment that allow the cost-effective and easy migration of obsolete BMSs to a system of the user's choice, improving the environmental control and energy efficiency of the building services.   

Hurtwood also offers wider plant consultancy and engineering services that deliver energy savings, improve control and low cost supplies of heat for industrial, commercial and public sector energy users. We are technical specialists in acute healthcare services but cover every other sector from commercial to munitions manufacture. We have a wealth of experience on industrial heat supply systems including steam and high temperature hot water, steam boiler plant and the industrial combustion of coal and wood.

Alongside consultancy, STL has also independently developed a range of proprietary power electronics technologies that are available under license. These include solutions for precision high-current/high-voltage arbitrary waveform generation from both mains and battery sources.

Our latest innovation, the patent-pending ‘Digital Variac’, is a smart/connected 3 kVA solid-state variable transformer module (utilizing direct high-frequency AC–AC conversion) that is intended as a drop-in replacement for traditional Variacs. It is scalable to tens of kVA and three-phase systems, offers Modbus/Ethernet/Webserver control, directly drives step-up/step-down transformers, and incorporates a built-in precision power analyser.

All STL systems leverage advanced technologies including planar magnetics, wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC/GaN), and DSP+FPGA-based control architectures. These platforms are deployed in high-power electrical testers as well as industrial applications.

Name: Identec Limited
Description:
We are a UK manufacturer of safe and secure, performance-driven, touch-free radio frequency identification (RFID) systems for commercial and industrial use.

Based in County Durham in the UK, for nearly 40 years we have pioneered the design and manufacturer of our own RFID systems, and our touch-tree products are now used worldwide.

These verified and trusted auto ID products control access, track assets, and manage the movement of people, places, and things, simply by their proximity to one of our devices, providing safe and secure working environments.

We invest heavily in the research and development of our core technology and in the protection of our intellectual property.

Our RFID touch-free pioneering technology is used across a range of applications bringing the benefits of increasing efficiency, reducing errors, and improving quality, adding speed, accuracy, efficiency, and security to your operations.

Applications range from safety registration, asset tracking, time & attendance registration to sports timing. 

The top 5 applications of Identec RFID technology are Access Control, Hygiene, Car Parking, Safety, and Asset Tagging, however, there are many more bespoke applications – talk to us about your needs to determine if RFID could be a solution for your business.

Name: Wilson Process Systems
Description:
WPS offers specialist PCB assembly, providing agile, responsive manufacturing services, that supports customers across the country.

Backed by over 40 years' experience, the company currently employs approximately 75 personnel and specializes in sub-contract printed circuit board assembly. We deliver anything from bare PCBs to fully tested, electro-mechanical assemblies from our 30,000ft2 production facilities and supply a range of industries. These include consumer, industrial, entertainment, medical, rail, defence, highway and urban signage, lighting and power generation. 

2016 was a record year for the company, with growth of 28 per cent, taking annual turnover to in excess of £12 million. A key policy of continual investment in new equipment helps us keep pace with customer demand and maintain competitiveness. This has seen further additions to the plant in 2016, with additional optical inspection and selective soldering equipment, as well as increased surface mount capacity. 

The latest addition to Wilson's equipment inventory is a Synchrodex Orissa 460 high-speed, flexible, in-line, modular selective soldering system configured with a drop-jet fluxer module and an infra-red pre-heat and soldering module. This greatly increases the repeatability and quality of the conventional soldering process through automation, while also maintaining competitive production costs. 

In total, the surface mount department has a capacity of over 300,000 component placements per hour with two Universal AdVantis AC 30 Lightning high-speed chip placement platforms, a Universal AdVantis AC 72, a Quad QSA-30 and a Quad QSP-2 pick and place machine, together with reflow ovens form Soltec, BTU and Speedline Electrovert. The company claims a position as the first UK contract electronics manufacturer to offer automated assembly of PCBs up to 1,200 by 500mm, including the vital solder paste printing process.

Name: Energy At Work Ltd
Description:
Specifying better lighting to save our clients energy, improve working and visitor environements, and reduce maintenence costs.
We frequently work with Carbon Trust and Salix funding. Our current clients include a major shopping centre, national retailer, several hotels, borough council, schools and typically any business with electricity costs over £5,000 annually.
With the latest 'Cree'-style LED lighting we can reduce energy consumption of traditional lighting by anything up to 85%.

Name: Gill Research & Development Limited
Description:

Name: Bartington Instruments Ltd
Description:
Bartington Instruments designs and manufactures high precision fluxgate magnetometers, gradiometers, magnetic susceptibility instruments and associated data processing equipment.

The company was founded in 1985, and in the 30 years since we have built up a vast body of experience that lets us manufacture sensors with maximised sensitivity, an absolute minimum of noise, wide bandwidth and low power consumption. Our fluxgates are manufactured to fulfil each order on our premises.

Our Research and Development team undertakes development contracts for a number of private and government organisations. We employ over 60 people in product manufacture, research and development, sales, marketing and administration.

Around 80% of our products are exported worldwide to customers working in the sectors of defence, aerospace, geophysics, industry, physics and archaeology, and oil and mineral exploration companies.

Name: WOEHNER (U.K.) LIMITED

Name: Bluefinled
Description:
Bluefin LED designs and manufactures patented marine LED lighting systems in the UK, supplying boat builders, refit yards, installers and distributors worldwide since 2014.

We engineer underwater lighting for projects where reliability below the waterline is critical. From leisure boats and RIBs to superyachts and commercial vessels, our products are developed to deliver dependable performance in demanding marine environments.

Our approach is different. We are one of the only marine lighting manufacturers to use mechanical O-ring and gasket sealing as standard, rather than glues or resin potting. This proven engineering approach provides a robust, serviceable solution designed for long-term reliability.

Innovation at Bluefin LED is driven by real-world installation. Working closely with boat builders, naval architects and marine electricians, we develop lighting systems that simplify installation, integrate with modern onboard electronics and perform throughout the vessel's life. Our Mini IYS intelligent lighting platform and Pro-Link RGBW range allow compatible multifunction displays to control underwater lighting through a single integrated system.

Every product is designed in-house, protected by patented technology, RINA approved and backed by a two-year warranty. We continue to invest in research and product development to meet the changing demands of the global marine industry.

Today, Bluefin LED products are installed through an international distributor network and trusted by professionals specifying new builds, refits and custom yacht projects around the world.

Whether you're specifying underwater lights for a production boat, integrating RGBW lighting into a superyacht, or looking for reliable marine lighting systems for a refit, we're here to help.

If you specify, install or refit marine lighting, this is where the technical questions get answered.

Name: LED Ideas Ltd
Description:
LED Ideas have over 40 years’ experience within the lighting industry. Today, we are established as pre-eminent providers of LED solutions. Description:

Europractice is a platform with a full range of services to design and fabricate microelectronic circuits and systems. For nearly 30 years, we have supported our customers in all critical steps from prototype design to volume production. 

The three pillars of Europractice Services are:

  Fabrication services
Cost-effective fabrication in technologies of leading foundries for both industrial and academic customers

 Design tools

Name: Uninterruptible Power from Rehlko
Description:

Name: Mixergy Ltd

Name: Cygnus Instruments Ltd
Description:
Cygnus Instruments Ltd is the leading manufacturer of multiple-echo ultrasonic thickness gauges used for measuring remaining metal thickness without the need to remove protective coatings.  Following extensive customer engagement, Cygnus have developed a new range of ultrasonic thickness gauges which still use the well established multiple-echo technique but incorporated within the PLUS models is single-echo and echo-echo measuring modes using twin crystal probes.  Single-echo and echo-echo can assist in obtaining measurements in areas of extreme corrosion or back wall pitting.

Cygnus has a range of measuring instruments which includes:

Surface thickness gauges: ATEX approved intrinsically safe gauge for use in Zone 0, Zone 1 hazardous areas and requires no plant shutdown or hot work permit; hands free gauge designed for climbing or rope access work where safe hands free operation is paramount; general purpose gauge with A-scan display and sequential data logging; and a more advanced gauge with A-scan and B-scan display, comprehensive data logging, manual gain control, Bluetooth, and much more.

Underwater thickness gauges: diver wrist-mountable data logging gauge with a large bright AMOLED A-scan display; ROV mountable range depth rated up to 4,000 meters with optional probe handling solutions; and the original RINA approved divers hand-held gauge depth rated to 300 meters.

And an ultrasonic hatch cover leak detector for testing weather tightness of cargo hold hatch covers and door seals.

Name: OXTS
Description:
At OXTS, we deliver precision positioning in all environments.

For more than 20 years, we’ve been passionate about engineering positioning and navigation systems that simply work -combining high-performance GNSS and inertial expertise to help customers capture accurate, reliable data wherever they operate.

Our solutions are trusted globally and have become a benchmark in automotive testing, built on a heritage of precision, reliability and real-world performance. Today, we’re just as excited to be pushing into new frontiers in survey, mapping and advanced localisation.

What really drives us is solving the hard problems: making positioning work when GNSS struggles or disappears altogether. With technologies like LiDAR Boost and WayFinder, and a flexible sensor fusion approach that goes beyond LiDAR to include cameras, wheel speed sensors and other inputs, we help customers unlock accurate, repeatable positioning in places like tunnels, dense urban environments and indoor spaces.

It’s this combination of deep engineering expertise and genuine enthusiasm for what’s possible that lets us help customers go further, test in new environments and build with confidence - wherever precision positioning is needed.

We work with our customers to provide complete turnkey solutions including: mould tool design & production, engineering, prototyping, assembly, overmoulding, and testing.

Low Pressure Injection Molding is the process of over-molding electronic devices with Polyamides to protect them. The PCB assembly or electronic part is placed in a specially manufactured aluminium mold tool, and completely surrounded with a liquid compound that effectively forms the housing for the device. It was developed by Henkel and initially introduced to European automotive manufacturing in the 1980’s.

Low Pressure Injection Molding is a faster, cleaner and lower cost alternative to encapsulation. The process is nontoxic, a great advantage when compared to potting with epoxies and or urethanes. Low Pressure Injection Molding is a 3 step process rather than an 8 step process for potting. This removal of process steps reduces manufacturing time, labour and material costs and improves throughput, resulting in increased ROI. There is zero waste, scrap is often recyclable and the process is environmentally friendly, giving off no toxic fumes. The end result is a tamperproof and environmentally sealed product.

Our founder realised early on that there was a strong need in the UK for an alternative to traditional potting processes, typically used to protect and encapsulate electronics. Engineering Solutions Ltd was incorporated in 2003 specialising in Low Pressure Moulding, (LPM) for the UK market. Our equipment is sourced from the USA and Europe and we are Henkel’s UK partner and experts in using their polyamides.

IoT solution provider for O&G and building monitoring

These include the recording of power consumption and the monitoring of movement, temperature, pressure, humidity as well as heating, cooling and air conditioning systems. 

With certifications according to ATEC, CE, ISO, QPS, TÜV and others, the products developed and manufactured by RCT in Germany stand for safe and tested device technology. For secure and fast data transmission, the manufacturer relies on state-of-the-art transmission technologies such as Cellular 4G/3G/2G, NBIoT, Sigfox, LoRaWAN, CatM1, LTE, WLAN, RF and GPRS.

Developers and programmers of software solutions

With the IoT platform "RCT Monitor" as well as IoT platforms, RCT has cloud-based solutions for applications in the "Internet of Things" of the energy world. This enables the simple, secure and scalable networking of physical objects such as IoT transmission units for tank and object monitoring and of PC-based systems.

Our products are available through multiple trusted sales channels, including our official online store, Amazon UK, eBay UK, and B&Q Marketplace, ensuring customers can purchase genuine ZOYI instruments through their preferred platform.

At ZOYI UK, we believe professional test equipment should be accurate, reliable, and accessible. Whether you’re troubleshooting complex electronics, maintaining industrial systems, testing electrical installations, or learning the fundamentals of measurement, our mission is to provide the tools that help you work with confidence.

This involves specifying the following:-

Valves, motors, gearboxes, pumps, vessels - based on media, temperature, environment (SELV, intrinsically safe, etc.), flow, speed, ratios, response time, etc.
Pipework – based on media, flow, density, pressure, temperature, etc.
Cables - based on environment, voltage, current, length, volt-drop, temperature, flexibility, mechanical protection, etc.
Enclosures – based on component layout dimensions, heat dissipation / cooling methods, environment, mechanical protection, support method, cable entries, operator accessibility, internal access requirements, customer preferences, etc.
Panel Components – based on function, capacity, voltage, price, size, availability, standard approvals, etc.
Component Layouts – based on component spacing requirements for cooling or EMC, separation of voltages, operator and maintenance accessibility, etc.

I am using Solid Edge CAD software to produce electrical schematic drawings, component layouts, cable schedules, labels and parts lists. I use Design Spark for 3D models for 3D printing.

Name: Power Quality Health Check Limited
Description:
Power Quality Expert developed the Power Quality Health Check in 2018 to be a singular power quality report writing solution for users of power quality analyser and power energy loggers, independent of the make or model of the instrument.

Power Quality Health Check operates through a simple portal interface allowing the users of analysers and loggers to remotely upload the raw survey datafiles directly to us. The survey data is analysed with a standardised power quality report produced and made available for download in PDF format.

The structured report documents recorded measurements of voltage, current, real power, apparent power, reactive power and power factor. Basic analysis of harmonics is presented utilising an intuitive traffic light system to visually indicate if levels of distortion require further investigation or are within acceptable limits.

Where areas of interest exist, the report will also contain commentary on the results to help you understand your measurements, propose areas for improvement and give basic advice on potential power quality solutions.

Power Quality Health Check supports a wide variety of power quality analysers and power energy loggers from test equipment manufacturers including Sonel, Fluke, Kewtech, Metrel, Elcomponent, Chauvin Arnoux and is available directly from Power Quality Expert or through our network of specialist test equipment distributors and test equipment hire companies.

In the present economic climate businesses are continually striving to reduce operating expenditure. One of the major financial outlays facing our clients is the ever increasing electricity bill. Name: MS Testing - Mariner Systems
Description:
Our test laboratory specializes in a comprehensive range of testing services, including environmental, marine type approval, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), ingress protection (IP), and flame retardancy testing. Equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, we provide rigorous assessments to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Environmental Testing: We simulate various environmental conditions to assess the durability and performance of products under extreme temperature, humidity, vibration, and other harsh environmental factors.

Marine Type Approval: Our marine testing services are tailored to evaluate products intended for use in marine environments, ensuring they meet the strict safety and performance standards necessary for operation in challenging conditions at sea.

EMC Testing: We test electronic devices for electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), ensuring they do not cause harmful interference and can function effectively in the presence of other electronic equipment.

IP Testing: Our ingress protection (IP) testing determines the level of protection products offer against dust, moisture, and other foreign objects, providing crucial information on their suitability for various environments.

Flame Retardancy Testing: We assess materials and products for their fire-resistant properties, testing their ability to withstand exposure to flames and minimize risk in high-temperature scenarios.

Our laboratory offers precise, reliable, and accredited testing to help manufacturers meet the regulatory requirements and safety standards needed to ensure product reliability, safety, and performance in real-world conditions.

Name: Nano Dimension
Description:
Nano Dimension (Nasdaq: NNDM) is a provider of intelligent machines for the fabrication of Additively Manufactured Electronics (AME). High fidelity active electronic and electromechanical subassemblies are integral enablers of autonomous intelligent drones, cars, satellites, smartphones, and in vivo medical devices. They necessitate iterative development, IP safety, fast time-to-market and device performance gains, thereby mandating AME for in-house, rapid prototyping and production. Nano Dimension machines serve cross-industry needs by depositing proprietary consumable conductive and dielectric materials simultaneously, while concurrently integrating in-situ capacitors, antennas, coils, transformers and electromechanical components, to function at unprecedented performance. Nano Dimension bridges the gap between PCB and semiconductor Integrated Circuits. Name: Sonatest
Description:
Sonatest operates from three company sites across the world: UK, USA and Canada. Our UK head office houses our global sales management, manufacturing, flaw detector research and design. Since our formation in 1958 Sonatest Ltd has grown to become one of the most respected suppliers of ultrasonic NDT instruments in the world with many global blue chip clients.

Name: UKBIC
Description:
The UK Battery Industrialisation Centre (UKBIC) is the UK’s national open-access facility dedicated to accelerating the scale-up of advanced battery technologies.

By bridging the gap between research and high-volume manufacturing, UKBIC plays a critical role in supporting the UK’s transition to net zero and strengthening its position in the global battery supply chain.

UKBIC provides state-of-the-art equipment, technical expertise, and training to help manufacturers and researchers validate processes, optimise performance, and reduce risk before committing to large-scale investment.

The facility offers both pilot and industrial-scale lines, enabling customers to trial new materials and processes under real-world conditions.

UKBIC also supplies its own benchmark products for component testing and delivers specialist training to develop the skills required for a battery-powered future. 

UKBIC is uniquely positioned to tackle complex manufacturing challenges. With expertise in processing diverse materials and products, and access to a broad range of advanced technologies, its engineers bring a comprehensive understanding of issues that span the entire battery value chain.

UKBIC is part of The Battery Innovation Programme, a flagship of the UK Industrial Strategy, funded by the Department for Business and Trade and delivered by Innovate UK.

For more information, visit: www.ukbic.co.uk
Or, get in touch with our Business Development Team at sales@ukbic.co.uk

- Reliable in extreme conditions: Instagrid products perform in challenging environments, from remote construction sites to high-demand film sets. 

With a growing network of satisfied customers across industries and continents, we’re helping businesses achieve their sustainability goals while powering how work gets done. Join us on this journey to cleaner, smarter energy solutions that don’t compromise on performance or reliability.

Name: Northern Switchgear Maintenance Solutions Ltd
Description: ACB onsite maintenance is at the heart of extending the useful working life of your critical safety devices. Name: Newson Gale
Description:
For over 40 years, Newson Gale has been in the business of protecting people and assets from static hazards serving industries where processes that generate significant amounts of static electricity have the potential to ignite flammable or explosive atmospheres.

Static electricity continues to be one of the industry’s most significant sources of igniting flammable and explosive gas and dust atmospheres. Statistics from leading organisations such as The Institute of Chemical Engineers and NFPA indicate that at least two serious fires or explosions are caused every day by uncontrolled static electrical discharges in industrial operations worldwide. 

The Newson Gale globally certified product range mitigates static charge accumulation by using practical and innovative design and ensures effective static control on three levels – grounding and bonding clamps, visual verification and interlockable control systems:
•	Static ground indicators and interlock systems via our Earth-Rite range.
•	Self-testing static electricity grounding clamp units via our Bond-Rite series.
•	Static grounding and bonding clamps, cables, and reels via our Cen-StatTM range.

Published data shows that ignitions from static discharges rank as highly as over-pressure faults in petrochemical handling and are second only to mechanical sparks for dust explosions.

Effective January 4, 2016, Newson Gale has become a member of the HOERBIGER Group.

• Lightbars
• Beacons
• Directional and warning lighting
• Work, scene and interior vehicle lighting
• Arrowbars
• LED message signs
• Sirens/PAs and speakers, and
• Flash controllers and switching systems

Description:
Based in Peterborough and fully accredited with NICEIC, we retrofit industrial & commercial premises and student accommodation with energy efficient LED lighting.  

Whilst changing to LED lighting will clearly save you money on your energy, and improve the environment for your customers and employees, our clients appreciate the fact that it also increases the asset value of their property. This can allow them to command higher rent levels, whilst also reducing maintenance requirements, which can cause a huge headache.

How do we work?
•In the first instance we would carry out a free, no-obligation lighting audit for you.  We would visit your site and carry out a full survey of your industrial lighting, from their size to fitting type and wattage consumption.  This allows us to give you a realistic guide of how much money you’d save by switching to LED.  

•We’d then fit a small test area with LED commercial lights and a monitoring system that displays before and after power readings.  This process will clearly showcase our unique fitting process as well as allowing you to review the performance levels for yourself.

•We fully appreciate that your decision on when to upgrade to LED lighting isn’t purely based on cost savings.  Finding the right time, that won’t inconvenience your customers and employees is imperative.  Our team have developed such a slick retro-fitting process, that they will barely know that we’ve been there.  We build all of the lighting off-site and then our 5 strong team, made up from our nationwide network of registered electrical contractors, will work together to remove and dispose of the old fitting, replace the new fitting and fill, paint and clean the area.  

•As part of our overall service, we can support you with advice on funding your LED lighting, which includes an interest-free funding solution.  In a nut-shell, we would supply and install your new LED lighting, you would save up to 50% on your running costs and these savings would pay for the LED lighting.  After that the savings would be yours.

•If you decide to go through with the full LED installation, we would put together a full design, installation and supply proposal bespoke to your needs.

•This would be the start of a beautiful partnership.  Your new LED lights would be fully insured for 5 years and you’d benefit from first rate after care from one of our senior management team.

Name: EVjuiceNgo
Description:
EVjuiceNgo is a British DC charging manufacturer focused on fleet environments where charging infrastructure becomes an operational dependency.

As fleets electrify, DC charging increasingly sits closer to daily operations, supporting vehicle availability, routes, and service delivery. In these environments, long-term cost and risk are shaped less by headline specifications and more by how systems behave once they are live.

Our background is in mission-critical DC power systems, where failures are investigated using evidence, operating limits are defined, and responsibility boundaries are treated explicitly. We apply that same engineering discipline to fleet DC EV charging.

DC power systems are long-lived operational assets. What matters is how behaviour is observed, how different causes are distinguished, and whether decisions can be made with confidence when conditions are not ideal.

Our approach is informed by decades of experience designing DC power systems where long-term operability depends on clarity, discipline, and restraint. In those environments, value comes from maintaining clarity over time, not from assuming ideal conditions or perfect continuity.

We apply the same engineering discipline used in mission-critical DC standby power, where availability is treated as fundamental and failure must be understood, to fleet EV charging.

EVjuiceNgo is designed for private and semi-private fleets that expect to scale, replace unreliable DC infrastructure, or expand existing depots, and who value operational clarity and long-term confidence over short-term simplicity.

We work with private and semi-private fleet operators, depot-based charging environments, and operations teams responsible for uptime, particularly those scaling infrastructure or replacing unreliable DC systems.

As we scale toward our goal of capturing 0.002% of the global retrofit market, we are delivering a scalable, hardware-first solution that moves the world closer to Net Zero.

Description:
Benford has been providing UV solutions for over 30 years. The company started in the early ‘90s by making UV & IR systems for the printing industry.

USES OF UVGI - ULTTRAVIOLET GERMICIDAL IRRADIATION

After Covid-19 outbreak, we committed to manufacturing the best and most efficient UVC germicidal solutions in the market by using our knowledge about UV and the same principles that we use for our other products.
UVGI (Ultraviolet Germicidal Irradiation) when applied in powerful doses can destroy the DNA or RNA of any microorganisms exposed to it, thus preventing it from spreading and decreasing the rate of infections.

The amount of inactivation is directly proportional to the UVC dose which is the result of its intensity (decreasing with distance to the lamp) and duration of exposure.

UVC light is a powerful solution for keeping the surfaces disinfected. However, it can be harmful to humans. Direct exposure can lead to skin burns and damage to the eyes. As a safety precaution when disinfecting rooms, humans and animals should not be present in the area during the process, or they should wear adequate protective clothing.

UVC & COVID-19 (SARS-CoV-2)

Published scientific research and studies have proven the effectiveness of using UVC light to deactivate various strains of coronavirus including the latest SAS-CoV-2 strain:

- University of Nebraska Medical Centre experimented on Covid-19 (SARS CoV-2) decontamination of rooms and protective equipment (N95 masks). For the experiment, the material was soiled with high levels of contaminated artificial skin oil and saliva and exposed to inactivated with proper use of UVGI (Ultraviolet germicidal irradiation).

- N95DECON it is an organisation (including Harvard University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, University of Michigan, etc.) that support the use of UVC from disinfecting N95 respirators from Covid-19.

MicroPulse is unique in that the user can communicate directly to the instrument which can easily provide elemental signals prior to summation.

In 2011, for its continued development and innovation of its MicroPulse 5 series of instruments, Peak was awarded the Queen’s Award for Enterprise, category Innovation, an accolade of which Peak NDT is extremely proud.

Name: Enervibe
Description:
Every connected sensor on Earth is limited by the same part: the battery. Enervibe removes it. 

Founded in Israel in 2018, we convert ambient vibration into continuous electrical power, and our edge is the Adjustable Kinetic Energy Harvester, a self-tuning system that follows a machine's real vibration as it drifts. Fixed frequency harvesters collapse the moment reality moves, losing up to 85% of their output after a shift of only 10%. Ours holds its peak, the way a solar panel tracks the sun. 

We proved the entire stack- harvester, power management, sensing, wireless, and cloud- inside a rotating truck tire: minus 40 to plus 120 degrees Celsius, shocks to 2,500 g, no service access, no batteries. If it survives there, every industrial asset is a milder problem. That tire-proven platform now scales along three paths: tire intelligence, industrial IoT and the self-powered Smart Shoe, with a sub-cubic-centimeter MEMS harvester in development to carry the same physics into biometric rings, Smart glasses, Smart watches,  hearables and medical patches. 

Energy from motion. Data without battery dependency. Follow Enervibe.

PyropanelTM is the first LED panel on the UK market to offer certified fire-rate compliance in addition to premium quality LED lighting.

WHAT ARE PANELS? 

Panels are a leading type of lighting for suspended ceilings, often found in public buildings and the workplace. 

WHY LED?

Although panel lighting was previously dominated by Fluorescent products, breakthroughs in LED technology has made LED the preferable choice for renovation projects and new builds. LED offers a multitude of compelling benefits including:

  Lower energy costs
  Longer lifespans
  Low Maintenance
  No flickering 
  High Light Quality
  No ultraviolet or infrared interference
  Low carbon footprint and energy consumption. 

WHY PyropanelTM? 

PyropanelTM is a premium LED lighting panel which offers all of the aforementioned benefits of LED lighting along with the highest possible standards of fire safety. 

PyropanelTM is the first LED Panel on the UK market to offer certified fire-rated compliance, tested according to BS476-22 and offering 30 minutes fire-resistance, allowing occupants more time to evacuate in the case of an emergency. 

If a fire incident were to occur, maintaining compliance with national fire-safety regulations can make the difference between life and death. PyropanelTM has been tested in the UK to ensure it complies with building and health and safety regulations to offer the safest possible lighting solution for you and your co-workers.

PyropanelTM complies with:
  Building Regulations Part B (2013)
  Building Regulations L2A & L2B
  Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005
  HSE - HSG38 Lighting at Work.

Delivered in person or through video conferencing and tailored to your requirements (specifiers,  end users, sales engineers, design engineers, electrical fitters).

Product Review:
A review of your conceptual or detailed design documentation to determine the appropriate safety legislation, applicable product standards and the necessary design verification tests required to demonstrate compliance.
A vital part of product innovation.

Test Object optimisation
Get the most from your test budget by verifying specific characteristics and constructional requirements from the least number of ‘reference designs’ to permit use of design rules to verify other ratings. Particularly useful when developing a modular product or range.

Inspection.
A visual inspection of test object(s) to double check everything is in order, including appropriate test connections and documentation, prior to submission to a test laboratory. This can avoid costly delays, failures and re-tests.

Design Verification Assessment:
Third party review to determine if the design of a ‘non-tested’ assembly complies with the requirements of the product standard when compared to a tested ‘reference design’.  Includes an inspection of test certificates and any other supporting evidence such as calculations, assessments and data sheets. 
On successful completion, a DVA certificate is issued, otherwise a gap analysis report.

Calculations:
In accordance with EN / IEC 61439-1 - Temperature-rise assessment of LV assemblies rated up to 1600A using the methods of EN IEC TR 60890. 
Effects of short-circuit currents on a ‘Non-Tested Structure’ by comparison to a ‘Tested Structure’ using the methods of EN/IEC 60865-1.

Name: VOLTRICS
Description:
Voltrics is developing a range of innovative, dynamic connectors specifically intended to be licence to partner businesses. 'Slip-Sphere' is the first of Voltrics's product offering.

Slip-Sphere is a dynamic electro-mechanical wiring harness joint that eliminates the need for cable flex in wiring harness assemblies by providing up to 90o of tilt in all directions and 360oof rotation.

The Slip-Sphere joint offers a versatile and compelling solution to cable harness failure, poor systemic reliability, imprecise service schedules and increases service life by over 300%.

The construction removes stress and work hardening of a cable and its associated components improving the lifespan and effectiveness of each part, making the system as a whole more reliable all the while ensuring repairs can be made locally to the damaged area and not affect the entire assembly.

The simple and considered design allows it to be scaled to suit its intended use-case and similarly can carry a varying number of channels as the product architecture requires. Slip-Sphere can be commissioned into a wide range of applications offering a dynamic solution for challenging wiring applications. 

Application scope is limited only by the imagination of the design engineer.

Name: ESM Global LTD (Optical Fibre Sensing)
Description:
ESM Global Ltd (“Engineering Services Management”) is an original-technology engineering and commercialisation platform established in the United Kingdom by the iFiber Group. ESM serves Europe’s industrial asset monitoring and integrity-management needs by transforming telecommunications-grade optical fibre into a continuous, real-time sensing network.

Built on more than a decade of distributed fibre-optic sensing (DFOS) research and deployment, ESM delivers standardised DTS, DAS, DSS and optical pressure-sensing solutions (including FBG and Fabry–Pérot cavity technologies). Using Rayleigh backscatter, stimulated Brillouin effects and fibre Bragg gratings, these solutions enable long-range, passive and high-reliability monitoring of temperature, strain, pressure and vibration. ESM operates through a full end-to-end delivery model covering scheme design, system integration, field deployment, calibration, acceptance, operations, maintenance and data interpretation.

On the data side, ESM has developed a proprietary AI-based interpretation stack supporting event recognition, source localisation, leak and intrusion discrimination, operating-state classification and trend forecasting. The platform is deployed across oil and gas, CCUS, long-distance pipelines, wind power, urban utilities, structural health monitoring and smart-city applications. 

Designed for secure, scalable and standards-compliant integration, ESM helps clients reduce downtime and environmental risk, optimise operating costs, and support decarbonisation and digital-transformation objectives.

 uses. This is by no means an easy process.

 Appropriate metering systems, installed so as to record consumption throughout an organisation, are able to provide owners and occupiers with the information necessary in order to take the first steps towards improving the energy efficiency of their businesses.

 reporting and compliance with increasing environmental legislation such as the CRC Energy Efficiency Scheme and ESOS.

Description:
Aurox Limited was established in 2004 to commercialise and build upon pioneering work from the Scanning Optical Microscopy Group at the University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science. 

A leader in the design and manufacture of innovative optical imaging equipment, Aurox has received multiple business and technology awards including, the Queen's Award for Enterprise, the Institute of Physics (IOP) Innovation award and the R&D100 award. 

Technology developed by the group has historically appeared inside several products from other major microscopy companies. The company is now forging ahead with its own further developed own branded products.

Aurox's leading products are the Clarity-The Affordable Confocal Upgrade and the Unity-The All-in-One Benchtop Confocal. 

Clarity is the first in a portfolio of new products under development by Aurox. Its revolutionary design delivers affordable confocal microscopy to a wider user community through its ability to attach to any conventional microscope and to provide high quality 3D images acquired in real time. 

Unity is built on the same core imaging technology and is a leader in the development of a new range of confocal microscopy systems. Unity is a compact benchtop, All-in-One device that can be used in the open lab environment. These systems address specific market needs in applications ranging from live cell imaging to high content screening.

Aurox products are designed to be financially accessible not only to imaging facilities but also to individual research groups.

Name: Verdel Instruments
Description:
Conventional tandem mass spectrometry (MS-MS) requires good separation of analytes upstream of the spectrometer – to maintain a clear and consistent association between analyte ions and any fragments born from them.

Separating analytes can be technically difficult and time-consuming, especially in samples containing many different analytes (biological samples, for example).

In addition, some separation techniques inadvertently remove analytes from the sample – which then never reach the spectrometer.

Verdel's unique TOC-MS technology ‘encodes’ each analyte ion with a unique modulation frequency. This modulation is passed onto any born fragments; so, analytes and fragments can be correlated, even when there are mixtures present in the spectrometer.

TOC-MS enables a simpler analytical method, with higher analyte coverage – saving time, improving confidence and generating new insight.

Name: FT Technologies Ltd
Description:
FT Technologies is a leading manufacturer of compact ultrasonic wind sensors known for their durability and accuracy. Powered by Acu-Res, each solid-state wind sensor is individually assembled and calibrated in our UK factory. Used by the world's leading wind turbine manufacturers, FT wind sensors have passed over 30 independent tests that include water ingress, ice, corrosion, sand, dust, hail, vibration, drop and lightning protection.

Acu-Res technology is FT's proprietary technology utilising acoustic resonance and is inherently different to Time-of-Flight (ToF). Unlike other ultrasonic sensors, FT wind sensors measure the phase change of acoustic waves to calculate airflow speed and direction. This ensures reliability in wind speed, direction and temperature data in the harshest of conditions.

Teknoware is the market leader in lighting solutions for public transport vehicles and the largest manufacturer of emergency lighting systems in the Nordic countries.

Name: FaultCurrent Ltd
Description:
FaultCurrent Ltd has developed a unique 11KV 30KA passive magnetic Fault Current Limiter (pmFCL), a Smart Grid technology that provides additional fault level headroom, when it is needed during a fault event, to quickly, safely and easily allow the connection of new Distributed Generation sources.

The patented technology behind this next generation FCL has been achieved through a combination of magnetic engineering insights, including using low-cost ferrite permanent magnets to saturate a network of inductors. The pmFCL provides additional fault current headroom but unlike a Current Limiting Reactor, presenting a low impedance during normal ‘in service’ current flows until an abnormal fault current instantaneously forces the device into a higher impedance state and in doing so allows time for the power system’s existing infrastructure the react to isolate the fault safely. Post fault the pmFCL instantly recovers ready to protect the network again.

Unlike other FCL’s, this breakthrough design is a truly ‘fit & forget’ technology, needing no auxiliary power sources, no specialist cooling or controls and critically introducing only minimal network losses.

Name: Stronger- Workout Tracker
Description:
Atlas Smart Technologies is a Northern Irish company aiming to become the market leader for home fitness solutions. It was founded in February 2021 and has 4 team members- all close friends, technology enthusiasts and avid gym-goers.
During lockdown, people realised that home workouts had great potential. They loved how convenient and accommodating to busy lifestyles they were. However, people struggled with a lack of suitable equipment. They missed the accountability and guidance that comes from training at a gym. Home gym set-ups were expensive and took up too much floor space. Adjustable dumbbells offered a solution, but existing market offerings did not have enough weight levels or took too long to adjust. The founding team believed there was a need for a better solution. 
Atlas, therefore, developed the solutions: Stronger Mobile and the SmartBell. Stronger Mobile is a workout tracking app which gamifies the fitness experience, providing accountability for users. It is available on iOS and Android. Stronger makes it easy to visualise progress, by comparing your workouts to relatable objects and landmarks to create a fun and engaging experience. Stronger also tracks your total weight statistics, allowing users to take on challenges such as cumulatively lifting the Statue of Liberty or other iconic structures. Detailed analytics are also available to drive progress so users can reach and surpass their goals. 
The SmartBell is an adjustable dumbbell which offers twenty-six different weight levels, ten more than the market leader. Atlas aims to combine Stronger and the SmartBell, creating a smart adjustable dumbbell. The company’s vision is to provide customers with any weight, anytime, anywhere - making fitness accessible to all.

The latter includes both the development and the production of pharmaceuticals, agrichemicals, fine chemicals, petrochemicals and bio-fuels. 

Fibre Photonics provide a range of ATR mid-infrared fibre optic immersion probes as a real-time in situ reaction monitoring solution within a laboratory and production environment. Each probe can be coupled to an FTIR spectrometer by means of SMA connectors and has been designed to withstand the ever changing requirements of a development laboratory, especially where high through-put or scale up reactions monitoring are required. 
Several key functional groups can be investigated using the broad spectral range of one single mid infrared immersion probe, including carbonyl, unsaturated hydrocarbon, amine and alkyl halide containing compounds. 

Each probe offers a real-time insight into common reactions used in the development of API’s, biofuels, fine and bulk chemicals including addition, substitution and condensation reactions as well as oxidation and reduction reactions. The close monitoring of the reactivity results in faster scale-up and reaction optimisation resulting in R&D time being saved in the laboratory.

Some of their components were in the original revision of our Pressure Testing System and they were the first guys we bought our first big (huge) order from to stock the place up. Even if we are sold out of the item, we can get parts from them within 48 hours - if we place the order on Monday afternoon - it will generally be here Wednesday morning - that's pretty awesome!.

We knew that we had the ability and love of the products to be able to create some of our own. Our first in-house developed product was the Proto-PIC Arduino Starter Kit. We have sold over 10,000 of these to date. We now have a full range of products that are our own concept and design.

At ScensAi (/seɴsei/), we are developing scalable electronic nose technology.

Our Innovation: Chemical modeling software that enables training transfer between devices, eliminating the need for individual unit setup. Our cloud-based learning platform enables every deployed device to contribute to a shared chemical signature library. As we train our models to detect new chemicals or applications, every device in the network gains that capability instantly.

- Food manufacturers can ensure quality across multiple sites.
- Environmental monitors can deploy affordable drone-based sensing.
- Wine producers can detect cork contamination instantly.
- Healthcare providers can access breath diagnostics without lab equipment.

Join us in making chemical sensing accessible, scalable, and interconnected.

Name: Teknek
Description:
We solve contamination problems
in high-end industrial processes.
Our mission and overarching goal is to help our customers
achieve defect-free, resource efficient, smart
manufacturing operations, using cleaning technology that
solves complex contamination and process challenges in
their specific application.
How do we do this? It began with a method we pioneered
called ‘Contact Cleaning’, that effectively and reliably
picks up loose particles and contaminations, ranging from
sub-micron size particles up to a size of 5mm and above
(including dust, metal, glass-fibres, human hair and skin).
Our method solves a problem known as ‘unattached
contamination’ which causes defects in a range of highend
industrial processes, like EV Battery manufacture and
PCB assembly.
In simple terms, our method uses an elastomer cleaning
roller to pick up contaminating particles, and securely
capture them on an adhesive surface. This means fewer
defects in manufacturing processes, reduction in waste,
maximised resource efficiency and improved yields.

Today, Teknek is part of ITW Inc. We’re the world leader in sheet and web cleaning, backed by a $15bn business.
